recipes.title: Macaroni and Cheese
recipes.description: Stovetop macaroni in a creamy sharp cheddar sauce made from a simple butter-and-flour roux.
steps: Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Cook the macaroni 1 minute less than the package directions (about 6 minutes), then drain.
While the pasta cooks, shred the cheddar.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook, whisking constantly, for 1 to 2 minutes without letting it brown.
Slowly whisk in the milk. Cook, whisking often, at a gentle simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, until the sauce thickens enough to coat a spoon.
Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until melted and smooth. Stir in the mustard, salt and pepper.
Add the drained macaroni and stir to coat; if the sauce is too thick, loosen it with a splash of milk.
Serve hot, sprinkled with paprika if you like.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
recipes.description: A classic buttery, golden grilled cheese with melted cheddar, cooked low and slow so the inside melts before the bread burns.
steps: Soften the butter and slice the cheddar thinly.
Spread butter evenly on one side of each slice of bread.
Heat a skillet over medium-low heat. Place one slice buttered side down, layer on the cheese, and top with the second slice, buttered side up.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until the bottom is deep golden brown. Flip and cook 2 to 3 minutes more, covering the pan with a lid if needed to finish melting the cheese.
Let rest 1 minute, then cut diagonally and serve.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup
recipes.description: A smooth, creamy tomato soup made from canned crushed tomatoes, onion and garlic, finished with a little cream.
steps: Dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and translucent. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, broth, sugar, dried basil, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, for 20 minutes.
Puree the soup with an immersion blender until smooth, or blend in batches in a countertop blender with the lid vented and covered with a towel.
Stir in the cream and rewarm over low heat without boiling. Taste and adjust the salt.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with chopped fresh basil if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Homemade chicken noodle soup with tender shredded chicken, carrots, celery and egg noodles in a thyme-scented broth.
steps: Dice the onion, slice the carrots and celery into 1/4-inch pieces, and mince the garlic.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until the onion is soft. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add the broth, thyme, bay leaves and whole chicken breasts. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer, cover and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and shred it with two forks.
Return the soup to a boil, add the noodles and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Stir the chicken back in, remove the bay leaves, and season with salt and pepper. Serve topped with chopped parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef tacos in warm corn tortillas with lettuce, tomato and cheddar.
steps: Finely dice the onion, mince the garlic, shred the lettuce and cheese, and dice the tomatoes.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the beef and onion for 7 to 8 minutes, breaking up the meat, until browned with no pink remaining. Drain off excess fat.
Stir in the garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add the taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, until the liquid has mostly cooked off.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for about 30 seconds per side, then wrap in a clean towel to keep them soft.
Fill each tortilla with beef and top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, and sour cream and salsa if using.

recipes.title: Chicken Tacos
recipes.description: Chili-lime seared chicken thighs chopped and served in corn tortillas with onion, cilantro and avocado.
steps: In a bowl, toss the chicken with 1 tablespoon of the oil, the juice of 1 lime, the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Let stand 10 minutes.
Heat the remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until browned and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then chop it into bite-size pieces.
Meanwhile, finely dice the red onion, chop the cilantro, slice the avocado and cut the second lime into wedges.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for about 30 seconds per side and wrap in a towel.
Fill the tortillas with chicken and top with onion, cilantro, avocado and salsa if using. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine topped with taco-seasoned beef, black beans, tomatoes, cheddar and crushed tortilla chips, dressed with a quick salsa-sour cream dressing.
steps: In a skillet over medium-high heat, cook the beef for 7 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat, stir in the taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water, and simmer 4 to 5 minutes until thickened.
Chop the romaine, dice the tomatoes, slice the green onions, shred the cheddar, and rinse and drain the beans.
Whisk the sour cream and salsa together to make the dressing.
Divide the lettuce among 4 bowls and top with the warm beef, beans, tomatoes, cheese, green onions and diced avocado if using.
Crush the tortilla chips over the top, drizzle with the dressing and serve right away.

recipes.title: Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crispy flour tortillas filled with melted Monterey Jack and cheddar, sautéed peppers, onion and black beans.
steps: Thinly slice the bell pepper and onion, rinse and drain the beans, and shred both cheeses.

Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the pepper and onion for 5 to 6 minutes, until soft. Stir in the beans, cumin and salt and cook 1 minute more. Transfer to a bowl and wipe out the skillet.
Sprinkle half of each tortilla with cheese, add some of the vegetable filling, top with a little more cheese and fold the tortilla over.
Lightly oil the skillet and cook the quesadillas over medium heat, two at a time, for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese is melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa if desired.

recipes.title: Burritos
recipes.description: Beef burritos filled with cilantro-lime rice, refried beans, seasoned ground beef and cheddar.
steps: Bring 2 cups water and the salt to a boil, stir in the rice, cover and simmer on low for 18 minutes. Rest off the heat 5 minutes, then fluff and stir in the lime juice and chopped cilantro.

Meanwhile, dice the onion and cook it with the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 7 to 8 minutes, until browned. Drain the fat, add the taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water, and simmer 4 to 5 minutes until thickened.
Warm the refried beans in a small saucepan or the microwave, and shred the cheese.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave for 30 to 45 seconds to make them pliable.
Spread beans down the center of each tortilla, then add rice, beef, cheese and a spoonful of salsa. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
If you like, sear the burritos seam side down in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Serve with sour cream and extra salsa.

recipes.title: Nachos
recipes.description: Sheet-pan nachos layered with seasoned beef, black beans and two cheeses, baked until melted and topped with fresh garnishes.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil.
Brown the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 7 to 8 minutes. Drain the fat, stir in the taco seasoning and 1/2 cup water, and simmer 3 to 4 minutes until thick.
Shred the cheeses, rinse and drain the beans, thinly slice the jalapeños and green onions, and dice the tomato.
Spread half the chips on the baking sheet and top with half the beef, beans, jalapeños and cheese. Repeat with the remaining chips, beef, beans, jalapeños and cheese.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Top with tomato, green onions and olives, and serve immediately with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Chili
recipes.description: A hearty beef and bean chili simmered with tomatoes, peppers and a blend of chili spices.
steps: Dice the onion and bell pepper and mince the garlic. Rinse and drain the beans.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef for 8 to 10 minutes, breaking it up, then drain off most of the fat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes, until softened.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin, oregano, smoked paprika, cayenne and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes with their juice, beans, broth and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low.
Simmer, partially covered, for 45 to 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick. Taste and adjust the salt.
Serve topped with shredded cheddar, sour cream and sliced green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.description: Ground beef simmered in a tangy-sweet tomato sauce and piled onto toasted buns.
steps: Finely dice the onion and bell pepper and mince the garlic.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the beef, onion and bell pepper for 8 to 10 minutes, breaking up the meat, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add the tomato sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire, mustard, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick.
Meanwhile, butter the cut sides of the buns if using and toast them in a skillet or under the broiler until golden.
Spoon the filling onto the buns and serve.

recipes.title: Hamburgers
recipes.description: Juicy grilled beef burgers seasoned simply with salt and pepper and served with classic toppings.
steps: Preheat the grill to medium-high, about 400 to 450°F.
Gently divide the beef into 4 portions and shape into patties about 3/4 inch thick and slightly wider than the buns. Press a shallow dimple into the center of each so they stay flat.
Slice the tomato and onion and separate the lettuce leaves.
Season both sides of the patties with salt and pepper just before cooking. Oil the grates.
Grill the burgers for 4 to 5 minutes per side, without pressing down, until the internal temperature reaches 160°F. Toast the buns cut side down on the grill for the last minute.
Rest the burgers 2 minutes, then assemble on the buns with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, ketchup and mustard.

recipes.title: Cheeseburgers
recipes.description: Skillet-seared beef patties topped with melted American cheese on toasted buttered buns.
steps: Divide the beef into 4 portions and shape into patties about 3/4 inch thick, slightly wider than the buns, with a shallow dimple in the center.
Slice the tomato and onion and separate the lettuce leaves.
Butter the cut sides of the buns and toast them in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat until golden. Set aside.
Season the patties on both sides with salt and pepper. Raise the heat to medium-high and cook the patties for 4 minutes without moving them.
Flip, top each with a slice of cheese, cover the pan and cook 3 to 4 minutes more, until the cheese melts and the internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Assemble the burgers on the toasted buns with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and condiments.

recipes.title: Hot Dogs
recipes.description: Grilled hot dogs in toasted buns with the classic toppings.
steps: Preheat the grill to medium, about 350 to 400°F. Finely dice the onion if using.
Make a few shallow diagonal cuts in each hot dog so they don't split.
Grill the hot dogs for 5 to 7 minutes, turning often, until heated through and marked on all sides.
Toast the buns cut side down on the grill for 30 to 60 seconds.
Place the hot dogs in the buns and top with mustard, ketchup, relish and onion as desired.

recipes.title: Meatloaf
recipes.description: A tender, classic beef meatloaf with a sweet and tangy ketchup glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.
In a large bowl, stir together the breadcrumbs and milk and let soak for 5 minutes. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic.
Add the beef, onion, garlic, eggs, 1/4 cup of the ketchup, the Worcestershire, thyme, salt and pepper. Mix gently with your hands just until combined.
Shape the mixture into a 9-by-5-inch loaf on the prepared baking sheet.
Whisk the remaining 1/2 cup ketchup with the brown sugar and vinegar. Spread half of the glaze over the loaf.
Bake for 45 minutes, spread on the remaining glaze, and bake 15 to 20 minutes more, until the internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Pot Roast
recipes.description: Beef chuck roast braised low and slow with onions, potatoes and carrots, served with a gravy made from the pan juices.
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F. Pat the roast dry and season all over with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the roast for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until deeply browned, then transfer to a plate.
Cut the onions into thick wedges and add them to the pot; cook 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and Worcestershire, scraping up the browned bits. Return the roast and any juices, and add the thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and braise in the oven for 2 hours.
Peel and cut the potatoes into 2-inch chunks and the carrots into 2-inch pieces. Nestle them around the roast, cover and return to the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until the meat is fork-tender.
Transfer the roast and vegetables to a platter and tent with foil. Discard the bay leaves and skim the fat from the liquid.
Bring the liquid to a simmer on the stovetop. Whisk the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water, stir it in and simmer 1 to 2 minutes, until thickened.
Slice or pull the roast into chunks and serve with the vegetables and gravy, garnished with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
recipes.description: Chunks of beef simmered with potatoes, carrots and celery in a rich, thick broth.
steps: Pat the beef dry, season with the salt and pepper, and toss with the flour.
Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef in two batches, 4 to 5 minutes per batch, and transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the diced onion and celery and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth, scraping up the browned bits. Add the Worcestershire, thyme, bay leaves and the beef with its juices.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Peel and cut the potatoes into 1-inch cubes and slice the carrots 1/2 inch thick. Add to the pot and simmer, uncovered, for 30 to 40 minutes, until the vegetables and beef are tender.
Stir in the peas and cook 5 minutes. Remove the bay leaves, taste for salt and serve.

recipes.title: Roast Beef
recipes.description: An herb-and-garlic crusted eye of round roasted to medium-rare and sliced thin, good hot for dinner or cold for sandwiches.
steps: Pat the roast dry, season all over with the salt and let it stand at room temperature for 1 hour (or refrigerate uncovered overnight and bring out 1 hour before cooking).
Heat the oven to 450°F. Mince the garlic, rosemary and thyme and stir them together with the oil and pepper.
Rub the herb paste over the roast and set it on a rack in a roasting pan.
Roast for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven to 325°F and roast 45 to 60 minutes more, until a thermometer in the center reads 125°F for medium-rare or 135°F for medium.
Tent loosely with foil and rest for 15 to 20 minutes; the temperature will rise about 5°F.
Slice very thinly against the grain and serve warm, or chill and slice for sandwiches.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.description: Tender chicken and vegetables in a creamy sauce baked between two flaky pie crusts.
steps: Place the chicken in a saucepan with the broth, bring to a simmer, cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes, until it reaches 165°F. Remove the chicken, dice it, and reserve 1 3/4 cups of the broth.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Let the pie crusts sit at room temperature for 15 minutes.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the diced onion and celery and cook 5 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the flour and cook 1 to 2 minutes. Slowly whisk in the reserved broth and the milk and simmer 3 to 5 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the chicken, frozen vegetables, thyme, salt and pepper and remove from the heat.
Fit one crust into a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate. Pour in the filling, top with the second crust, trim and crimp the edges, and cut 4 small vents in the top.
Beat the egg with 1 tablespoon water and brush it over the crust.
Bake on a rimmed baking sheet for 30 to 35 minutes, until the crust is golden and the filling bubbles, covering the edges with foil if they brown too quickly.
Let cool 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.description: Crispy breaded chicken cutlets baked with marinara and melted mozzarella, served over spaghetti.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally to make 4 cutlets and pound them to an even 1/2-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Set up three shallow dishes: the flour; the eggs beaten with 1 tablespoon water; and the panko mixed with 1/4 cup of the Parmesan and the Italian seasoning.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, dip in egg, then press firmly into the panko mixture.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the cutlets 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden, and transfer to a baking dish.
Spoon 2 tablespoons of marinara over each cutlet and top with the mozzarella and remaining Parmesan.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, drain, and toss with the remaining marinara, warmed.
Serve the chicken over the spaghetti, topped with torn basil if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo
recipes.description: Fettuccine tossed in a rich garlic-Parmesan cream sauce and topped with sliced seared chicken.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the fettuccine until al dente, reserving 1 cup of the pasta water before draining.

Meanwhile, season the chicken with the salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes per side, until it reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the minced garlic and cook 30 to 60 seconds, until fragrant.
Pour in the cream and simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Lower the heat and whisk in the Parmesan a little at a time until smooth.
Add the fettuccine and toss to coat, adding pasta water a splash at a time if the sauce is too thick.
Serve topped with the sliced chicken, black pepper and chopped parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki
recipes.description: Bite-size chicken thighs glazed in a homemade soy-ginger teriyaki sauce and served over jasmine rice.
steps: Rinse the rice, then combine it with 2 1/4 cups water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low and cook 15 minutes. Rest off the heat 10 minutes.
Whisk together the soy sauce, 1/4 cup water, brown sugar, honey, vinegar, minced garlic and grated ginger. In a separate cup, stir the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and pat dry.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked to 165°F.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in the cornstarch mixture and cook 1 minute more, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Serve over the rice, sprinkled with sesame seeds and sliced green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken
recipes.description: Simple oven-baked chicken breasts with a paprika-garlic rub that stay juicy in a hot oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Pound the thick end of each chicken breast to an even 3/4-inch thickness, pat dry and rub with the oil.
Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, salt and pepper, and season the chicken on both sides.
Arrange the chicken in a baking dish so the pieces aren't touching.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes, then squeeze lemon over the top and sprinkle with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Buttermilk-brined drumsticks dredged in seasoned flour and fried until crisp and golden.
steps: Whisk the buttermilk, hot sauce, 2 teaspoons of the salt and 1 teaspoon of the pepper in a large bowl. Add the chicken, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.

In a shallow dish, whisk the flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, baking powder and the remaining salt and pepper. Drizzle in 2 tablespoons of the buttermilk marinade and rub it in with your fingers to make small clumps.
Lift the chicken from the marinade, letting the excess drip off, and press each piece firmly into the flour mixture. Set on a wire rack for 15 minutes so the coating sets.
Heat about 1 1/2 inches of oil in a large Dutch oven to 350°F. Set a wire rack over a baking sheet and heat the oven to 200°F.
Fry the chicken in batches without crowding, turning occasionally, for 12 to 15 minutes, keeping the oil between 300°F and 325°F, until deep golden and the internal temperature reaches 175°F.
Drain on the rack and keep warm in the oven while frying the rest. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: Lemon-garlic marinated chicken breasts grilled until lightly charred and juicy.
steps: Pound the chicken breasts to an even 3/4-inch thickness.
Whisk the oil, the zest and juice of the lemon, minced garlic, oregano, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Add the chicken, turn to coat, and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 4 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high, about 425 to 450°F, and oil the grates.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill 5 to 7 minutes per side, until it has grill marks and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice and sprinkle with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Chicken and crisp-tender broccoli, carrots and bell pepper tossed in a ginger-garlic soy sauce over rice.
steps: Bring 3 cups water to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low for 18 minutes; rest 5 minutes off the heat.
Slice the chicken into thin strips and toss with 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch.

Whisk the broth, remaining soy sauce, honey, vinegar, sesame oil and remaining cornstarch to make the sauce. Slice the carrots and bell pepper, cut the broccoli into small florets, and mince the garlic and ginger.
Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken 4 to 5 minutes, until cooked through, and transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the carrots and broccoli and stir-fry 2 minutes. Add 2 tablespoons water, cover and steam 2 minutes. Add the bell pepper and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds. Return the chicken, pour in the sauce and toss 1 to 2 minutes, until thickened and glossy.
Serve over the rice, topped with sliced green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas
recipes.description: Spiced chicken strips seared with peppers and onions and served sizzling in warm flour tortillas.
steps: Slice the chicken into thin strips. Toss with 1 1/2 tablespoons of the oil, the juice of 1 lime, and the chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Let stand 15 minutes or refrigerate up to 4 hours.
Slice the bell peppers and onion into thin strips.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large cast-iron skillet over high heat. Cook the chicken in a single layer for 5 to 6 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked to 165°F. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, peppers and onion and cook 5 to 7 minutes, until crisp-tender and charred in spots.
Return the chicken to the pan and squeeze the second lime over everything.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in foil in a 350°F oven for 10 minutes.
Serve the fajita mixture in the tortillas with sour cream, salsa, sliced avocado and cilantro as desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: Corn tortillas rolled around a creamy shredded chicken and cheese filling, baked under homemade red enchilada sauce.
steps: Place the chicken in a saucepan, cover with water by an inch and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes, until it reaches 165°F. Cool slightly and shred.
For the sauce, heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute, then add the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and oregano and cook 30 seconds.
Whisk in the tomato paste, then slowly whisk in the broth. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes, until slightly thickened, and season with the salt.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Shred the cheese and finely dice the onion. Mix the chicken, onion, sour cream, half the cheese and 1/2 cup of the sauce.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave 45 seconds so they don't crack.
Spread 1/2 cup sauce in a 9-by-13-inch baking dish. Fill each tortilla with a scant 1/2 cup filling, roll up and place seam side down in the dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the enchiladas and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbly. Garnish with chopped cilantro if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Romaine tossed in a creamy lemon-Parmesan Caesar dressing with seared chicken and homemade croutons.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cut the bread into 3/4-inch cubes, toss with 2 tablespoons of the oil, the garlic powder and a pinch of salt, and bake on a sheet pan 12 to 15 minutes, until golden and crisp.

Season the chicken with the remaining salt and 1/2 teaspoon of the pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook 6 to 7 minutes per side, until it reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
For the dressing, whisk the mayonnaise, 1/4 cup of the Parmesan, the juice of the lemon, the mustard, Worcestershire, minced garlic, remaining 2 tablespoons oil and remaining pepper.
Chop the romaine into bite-size pieces and toss with the dressing.
Divide among plates and top with the chicken, croutons and remaining Parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Sandwiches
recipes.description: Classic creamy chicken salad with celery, grapes and green onion, served on soft bread with lettuce.
steps: Place the chicken in a saucepan, cover with salted water and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes, until it reaches 165°F. Cool completely and dice.
Finely dice the celery, halve the grapes and slice the green onions.
In a bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Fold in the chicken, celery, grapes and green onions. Chill for at least 30 minutes.
Divide the chicken salad among 4 slices of bread, top with lettuce and the remaining bread, and cut in half.

recipes.title: BBQ Chicken
recipes.description: Grilled drumsticks with a smoky dry rub, cooked over indirect heat and finished with a sticky barbecue sauce glaze.
steps: Pat the drumsticks dry and toss with the oil. Mix the brown sugar, smoked paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper and rub it all over the chicken.
Set up the grill for two-zone cooking, with one side on medium-high and the other off, aiming for about 375 to 400°F with the lid closed.
Grill the chicken on the cooler side, lid closed, for 30 to 35 minutes, turning occasionally, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Move the chicken to the hot side and brush with sauce. Grill 2 to 3 minutes per side, brushing with more sauce, until sticky and lightly charred and the internal temperature reaches 175°F.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with the remaining sauce, warmed.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork
recipes.description: Slow-cooker pork shoulder with a smoky-sweet rub, shredded and tossed in barbecue sauce for sandwiches.
steps: Mix the brown sugar, smoked paprika, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder and cayenne.
Cut the pork into 3 or 4 large chunks and rub the spice mixture all over.
Slice the onion and spread it in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker. Set the pork on top and pour the vinegar and broth around it.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 5 to 6 hours, until the pork shreds easily with a fork.
Transfer the pork to a large bowl, shred with two forks and discard any large pieces of fat. Skim the fat from the cooking liquid.
Toss the pork with 1 cup of the barbecue sauce and about 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid.
Toast the buns and pile on the pork. Serve with the remaining sauce and pickles if desired.

recipes.title: Pork Chops
recipes.description: Pan-seared boneless pork chops basted with garlic-thyme butter.
steps: Pat the pork chops dry. Mix the salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika and season both sides of the chops.
Heat the oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Sear the chops for 4 minutes without moving them, until golden brown, then flip.

Reduce the heat to medium and add the butter, lightly smashed garlic cloves and thyme. Tilt the pan and spoon the melted butter over the chops for 3 to 4 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Rest the chops 5 minutes and serve with the pan butter spooned over the top.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Sandwiches
recipes.description: Simple deli ham and Swiss sandwiches with mayo, Dijon, lettuce and tomato.
steps: Lay out the bread. Spread mayonnaise on 4 slices and Dijon mustard on the other 4.
Slice the tomato if using and separate the lettuce leaves.
Layer the ham and Swiss cheese on the mayonnaise slices, then add lettuce and tomato.
Top with the mustard slices, press gently and cut in half diagonally.

recipes.title: BLT Sandwiches
recipes.description: Crisp oven-baked bacon, lettuce and ripe tomato on toasted bread with mayonnaise.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Arrange the bacon on a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet and bake 15 to 20 minutes, until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Slice the tomatoes 1/4 inch thick and season lightly with salt and pepper. Separate the lettuce leaves.
Toast the bread and spread one side of each slice with mayonnaise.
On 4 slices, layer lettuce, tomato and 3 slices of bacon. Top with the remaining bread and cut in half.

recipes.title: Turkey Sandwiches
recipes.description: Deli turkey and cheddar on whole wheat with crisp romaine, tomato and a swipe of mayo and mustard.
steps: Lightly toast the bread if desired.
Thinly slice the cheddar, tomato and red onion, separate the romaine leaves, and slice the avocado if using.
Spread mayonnaise on 4 slices of bread and mustard on the other 4.
Layer the turkey, cheddar, romaine, tomato, onion and avocado on the mayonnaise slices.
Top with the mustard slices and cut in half.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad Sandwiches
recipes.description: Classic tuna salad with celery, red onion and sweet relish on soft bread with lettuce.
steps: Drain the tuna well and flake it into a bowl with a fork.
Finely dice the celery and red onion.
Add the celery, onion, mayonnaise, relish, lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper to the tuna and stir until combined.
Spread the tuna salad on 4 slices of bread, top with lettuce and sliced tomato if using, and close with the remaining bread.
Cut in half and serve, or refrigerate the tuna salad up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Club Sandwiches
recipes.description: Triple-decker toasted sandwiches stacked with turkey, ham, bacon, cheese, lettuce and tomato.
steps: Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until crisp. Drain on paper towels and cut each slice in half.
Toast the bread. Slice the tomatoes and season with pepper; separate the lettuce leaves.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of 8 slices of toast and on both sides of the remaining 4 slices.

For each sandwich, layer a slice of toast (mayo up) with turkey, cheese, lettuce and tomato. Add a double-mayo slice, then ham, bacon, lettuce and tomato, and finish with a toast slice, mayo side down.
Secure each sandwich with 4 toothpicks and cut into 4 triangles.

recipes.title: Philly Cheesesteaks
recipes.description: Thin-sliced steak and caramelized onions griddled with melted American cheese and piled into hoagie rolls.
steps: Freeze the steak for 30 to 45 minutes, until firm, then slice it as thinly as possible against the grain.
Thinly slice the onion and the bell pepper if using.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and pepper for 8 to 10 minutes, until soft and browned, then push to one side.
Add the remaining oil and the steak in a single layer, season with salt and pepper, and cook 2 to 3 minutes, chopping with a spatula, until no longer pink. Mix with the onions.
Divide the meat into 4 portions in the pan, lay 2 slices of cheese over each and let melt for about 1 minute.
Split the rolls without cutting all the way through, set each open roll over a portion, then slide a spatula underneath and flip it into the roll. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Grilled Steak
recipes.description: Sirloin steaks seasoned simply with salt, pepper and garlic and grilled over high heat to medium-rare.
steps: Take the steaks (about 1 inch thick) out of the refrigerator 30 minutes before grilling and pat them dry with paper towels.
Rub the steaks with the olive oil, then season both sides with the salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Heat a gas grill to high (about 450-500°F) or prepare a hot charcoal fire, then clean and oil the grates.
Grill the steaks with the lid closed for 4 to 5 minutes, until they release easily and have good grill marks.
Flip and grill 3 to 5 minutes more, until an instant-read thermometer reads 130°F for medium-rare or 140°F for medium.
Move the steaks to a cutting board, top each with a pat of butter if using, and rest 5 to 10 minutes.
Slice against the grain, sprinkle with parsley if using, and serve.

recipes.title: Steak and Potatoes
recipes.description: Pan-seared sirloin basted with garlic-rosemary butter, served with crisp oven-roasted potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Scrub the potatoes and cut them into 1-inch chunks.
Toss the potatoes on a rimmed baking sheet with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil, 1 teaspoon of the salt, 1/2 teaspoon of the pepper, the garlic powder and the paprika. Spread in a single layer.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once halfway, until golden and tender inside.
While the potatoes roast, pat the steak dry and season both sides with the remaining 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Sear the steak 4 minutes without moving it, then flip.
Add the butter, smashed garlic cloves and rosemary to the pan. Tilt the pan and spoon the foaming butter over the steak for 3 to 4 minutes, until it reaches 130°F for medium-rare.
Rest the steak on a cutting board for 5 to 10 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Serve the steak with the potatoes, spooning the pan butter over the top and garnishing with parsley if using.

recipes.title: Meatballs
recipes.description: Tender beef and pork meatballs bound with milk-soaked breadcrumbs and Parmesan, baked until browned.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with foil or parchment.
In a large bowl, stir together the breadcrumbs and milk and let sit 5 minutes until the crumbs soften.
Add the beef, pork, egg, Parmesan, minced garlic, chopped parsley, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Mix gently with your hands just until combined.
Roll into 1 1/2-inch balls (about 24) and arrange them on the baking sheet.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until browned and the internal temperature reaches 160°F.
If serving with sauce, warm the marinara in a large skillet, add the meatballs and simmer 5 minutes to coat.

recipes.title: Sausage and Peppers
recipes.description: Browned Italian sausages cooked with sweet peppers and onions until soft and jammy.
steps: Slice the peppers and onion into 1/4-inch strips and thinly slice the garlic.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sausages and brown on all sides, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the peppers and onion to the skillet with the salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, oregano and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth, scraping up the browned bits, and return the sausages to the pan.
Cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 10 to 12 minutes, until the sausages reach 160°F inside.
Serve the sausages and peppers as is or tucked into toasted buns.

recipes.title: Spaghetti and Meatballs
recipes.description: Beef and pork meatballs browned and simmered in a simple garlic tomato sauce, served over spaghetti.
steps: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes. Add the beef, pork, egg, 1/2 cup of the Parmesan, 2 minced garlic cloves, the parsley, 1 teaspoon of the salt and 1/4 teaspoon of the pepper. Mix gently and roll into 1 1/2-inch meatballs.
Heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a large, deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Brown the meatballs in batches on all sides, about 6 minutes per batch, and set aside.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat, add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and the diced onion, and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the remaining 3 minced garlic cloves and cook 30 seconds.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, basil, oregano, sugar, 1 teaspoon of the salt and the remaining pepper. Bring to a simmer.
Return the meatballs to the sauce, cover partially and simmer gently for 25 minutes, until the meatballs reach 160°F inside.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the remaining salt and cook the spaghetti until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain.
Serve the spaghetti topped with sauce and meatballs, the remaining Parmesan and torn basil if using.

recipes.title: Lasagna
recipes.description: Classic layered lasagna with a beef and tomato meat sauce, seasoned ricotta and plenty of mozzarella.
steps: Brown the ground beef with the diced onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 8 minutes. Drain excess fat and add the minced garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, Italian seasoning, sugar, 2 teaspoons of the salt and the pepper. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil, add 2 teaspoons of the salt and cook the lasagna noodles until just al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain and lay flat on a sheet of parchment or foil so they don't stick together.
In a bowl, mix the ricotta, egg, 1/2 cup of the Parmesan, the parsley and the remaining 1 teaspoon salt.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Spread 1 cup of meat sauce in a 9x13-inch baking dish and top with 4 noodles.
Layer half the ricotta mixture, 1 1/3 cups mozzarella and about 1 1/2 cups sauce. Repeat with 4 noodles, the remaining ricotta, 1 1/3 cups mozzarella and more sauce.
Finish with the last 4 noodles, the remaining sauce, the remaining mozzarella and the remaining Parmesan.
Cover with foil (tented so it does not touch the cheese) and bake 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 20 to 25 minutes more, until bubbling and browned in spots.
Let the lasagna rest for 15 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
recipes.description: Ziti tossed with marinara and creamy ricotta, then baked under a blanket of mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the salt and cook the ziti 2 minutes less than the package directions. Drain.
In a bowl, stir together the ricotta, egg, 1/4 cup of the Parmesan, the Italian seasoning, garlic powder and pepper.
Toss the drained ziti with 3 cups of the marinara and 1 1/2 cups of the mozzarella.
Spread half the pasta in the dish, dollop the ricotta mixture over it, then top with the remaining pasta.
Pour the remaining 1 cup marinara over the top and sprinkle with the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more until bubbling and golden.
Rest 10 minutes and garnish with torn basil if using before serving.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
recipes.description: Jumbo pasta shells filled with a spinach and three-cheese ricotta filling and baked in marinara.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Cook the shells in a large pot of boiling water with 2 teaspoons of the salt until just al dente, about 9 minutes. Drain, rinse with cool water and lay them out on a baking sheet so they don't stick.
Thaw the spinach and squeeze it very dry in a clean towel.
In a bowl, mix the spinach, ricotta, 1 cup of the mozzarella, 1/4 cup of the Parmesan, the egg, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, the remaining 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper.
Spread 1 1/2 cups of marinara in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Fill each shell with about 2 tablespoons of filling and arrange them open side up in the dish.
Spoon the remaining marinara over the shells and sprinkle with the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 minutes more until the cheese is melted and the sauce bubbles.
Let stand 5 minutes and garnish with basil if using.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.description: Fettuccine tossed in a rich sauce of butter, cream, garlic and Parmesan.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add 2 1/2 teaspoons of the salt. Cook the fettuccine until al dente, about 10 minutes, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook 1 minute without browning.
Pour in the cream, bring to a gentle simmer and cook 4 to 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Reduce the heat to low and whisk in the Parmesan a handful at a time until smooth. Season with the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, the pepper and the nutmeg if using.
Add the drained fettuccine to the sauce and toss well, adding splashes of pasta water as needed to loosen it.
Serve right away, topped with parsley if using.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta
recipes.description: Penne tossed with basil pesto, Parmesan and a squeeze of lemon, ready in about 20 minutes.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the salt and cook the penne until al dente, about 11 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup of the pasta water, then drain the pasta and return it to the pot off the heat.
Add the pesto, half the Parmesan and 1/4 cup of the pasta water and toss until the pasta is evenly coated and glossy, adding more water if it looks dry.
Squeeze in the lemon juice and season with the pepper.
Serve topped with the remaining Parmesan, diced tomato and torn basil if using.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
recipes.description: Italian-style pasta salad with pepperoni, mozzarella, crunchy vegetables and a red wine vinaigrette.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add 1 tablespoon of the salt and cook the penne until al dente. Drain, rinse under cold water until cool and drain well.
Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, mustard, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, sugar, pepper and the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons salt in a small bowl.
Quarter the pepperoni slices, dice the bell pepper, cucumber and tomatoes, thinly slice the red onion and slice the olives.
In a large bowl, combine the pasta, pepperoni, vegetables, olives and mozzarella.
Pour the dressing over the salad, add the Parmesan and toss well.
Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Toss again before serving.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
recipes.description: Egg noodles, tuna and peas in a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with cheddar and buttery crumbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 3-quart baking dish.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add 2 teaspoons of the salt and cook the egg noodles 1 minute less than the package directions. Drain.
Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the diced onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the soup and milk until smooth, then add the drained tuna, peas, 3/4 cup of the cheddar, the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and the pepper.
Fold in the noodles and spread the mixture in the baking dish.
Melt the remaining butter, toss it with the panko and sprinkle over the casserole with the remaining cheddar.
Bake uncovered 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbling and the topping is golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
recipes.description: Tender green beans in a creamy mushroom sauce, baked and topped with crispy fried onions.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Trim the green beans and cut them into 2-inch pieces. Boil them in water with the salt for 5 minutes, until crisp-tender, then drain and rinse with cold water.
In a 2-quart baking dish (such as 11x7-inch), stir together the soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper.
Stir in the green beans and 2/3 cup of the fried onions.
Bake for 25 minutes, until hot and bubbling.
Stir, top with the remaining 2/3 cup fried onions and bake 5 minutes more until the onions are golden.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
recipes.description: A make-ahead casserole of sausage, shredded potatoes, peppers and cheddar baked in a savory egg custard.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Brown the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into crumbles, until no longer pink, about 7 minutes. Add the diced onion and bell pepper and cook 4 minutes more.
Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes, then squeeze out as much liquid as possible in a clean towel.
Add the potatoes to the skillet with 1/2 teaspoon of the salt and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes until they start to soften. Spread the mixture in the baking dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, garlic powder, pepper and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt. Stir in 1 1/2 cups of the cheddar.
Pour the egg mixture evenly over the sausage and potatoes and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar. To make ahead, cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours, then add 10 to 15 minutes to the baking time.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes, until the center is set and a knife inserted near the middle comes out clean (160°F).
Rest 10 minutes, sprinkle with green onions if using, and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Chicken and Rice Casserole
recipes.description: Chicken, rice and broccoli baked together in a from-scratch creamy sauce and finished with cheddar.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook the diced onion until soft, about 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the broth and milk and bring to a simmer, stirring, until slightly thickened. Season with the salt, pepper and thyme.
Spread the uncooked rice in the baking dish. Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and scatter it over the rice, then pour the sauce over everything and stir to combine.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 40 minutes.
Stir in the broccoli, re-cover and bake 10 to 15 minutes more, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Uncover, sprinkle with the cheddar and bake 5 minutes until melted. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
recipes.description: A Midwestern hotdish of seasoned ground beef and vegetables in a creamy sauce, covered with crispy tater tots.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cook the ground beef and diced onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up the meat, until browned, about 8 minutes. Drain the fat and stir in the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Season with the salt, pepper and Worcestershire, then stir in the soup, sour cream and frozen vegetables.
Spread the mixture in the baking dish and sprinkle with 1 cup of the cheddar.
Arrange the frozen tater tots in a single tight layer over the top.
Bake uncovered 35 to 40 minutes, until the tots are crisp and golden and the filling bubbles.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheddar, bake 5 minutes more to melt, and rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Beef and Noodle Casserole
recipes.description: Egg noodles layered with a tomato beef sauce and a creamy sour cream filling, baked with cheddar.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add 2 teaspoons of the salt and cook the noodles until just al dente. Drain.

Brown the beef with the diced onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat, about 8 minutes. Drain the fat, add the minced garlic for 30 seconds, then stir in the tomato sauce, sugar, the remaining 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Simmer 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese and sour cream until smooth, then stir in the green onions and the noodles.
Spread the noodle mixture in the baking dish and top with the meat sauce.
Sprinkle evenly with the cheddar.
Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbling and the cheese is melted. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: Savory ground beef and vegetables in a rich gravy, topped with buttery mashed potatoes and baked until golden. This American version uses beef rather than lamb.
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into 2-inch chunks and cover with cold water in a large pot. Add 2 teaspoons of the salt, bring to a boil and cook until fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F. While the potatoes cook, brown the beef in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat, about 7 minutes, then drain the fat.
Add the diced onion and carrots and cook until softened, about 6 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.

Sprinkle in the flour and stir 1 minute, then add the broth, Worcestershire, thyme, the remaining 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes, then stir in the peas.
Drain the potatoes well and mash with 3 tablespoons of the butter, the milk and 1/4 teaspoon of the pepper until smooth.
Spread the mashed potatoes over the filling (or transfer the filling to a 2-quart baking dish first), sealing to the edges. Rough up the top with a fork and dot with the remaining butter.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbling at the edges, then broil 2 to 3 minutes to brown the top. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.description: Bell peppers stuffed with a seasoned beef, rice and tomato filling and baked with melted cheddar.
steps: Bring 1 cup of the water to a boil, stir in the rice, cover and simmer over low heat until tender and the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Cut the tops off the peppers, remove the seeds and ribs, and stand them upright in a baking dish just large enough to hold them.
Brown the beef with the diced onion in a skillet over medium-high heat, about 8 minutes. Drain the fat and add the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the cooked rice, diced tomatoes with their juice, 1/2 cup of the tomato sauce, the Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Simmer 2 minutes.
Spoon the filling into the peppers, packing it lightly, and pour the remaining tomato sauce over the tops. Add the remaining 1/4 cup water to the bottom of the dish.
Cover with foil and bake 35 to 40 minutes, until the peppers are tender.
Uncover, top with the cheddar and bake 10 minutes more until melted. Garnish with parsley if using.

recipes.title: Baked Potatoes
recipes.description: Oven-baked russet potatoes with crisp salted skins and fluffy insides, served with classic toppings.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Scrub the potatoes, dry them well and prick each several times with a fork.
Rub the potatoes with the oil and sprinkle all over with the salt.
Place directly on the oven rack with a sheet pan on the rack below and bake 50 to 60 minutes, until the skins are crisp and the centers are tender (about 205°F inside).
Split each potato lengthwise, push the ends toward the center to fluff, and add a tablespoon of butter and a pinch of pepper.
Top with sour cream, shredded cheddar and green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Mashed Potatoes
recipes.description: Creamy, buttery mashed russet potatoes, a classic side for roasts and holiday dinners.
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut into 2-inch chunks.
Put the potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch and add 1 tablespoon of the salt. Bring to a boil and simmer until a knife slides in easily, 15 to 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, warm the milk and butter in a small saucepan until the butter melts.
Drain the potatoes well and return them to the hot pot over low heat for 1 minute to dry out.
Mash with a potato masher or ricer, then stir in the warm milk mixture, the sour cream, the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and the pepper until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve topped with green onions if using.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
recipes.description: Thinly sliced potatoes baked in a creamy garlic and thyme white sauce until tender and golden on top.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13-inch baking dish with 1 tablespoon of the butter.
Peel the potatoes and slice them 1/8 inch thick.
Melt the remaining 4 tablespoons butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook the finely diced onion until soft, about 4 minutes, then add the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk and cook, stirring, until the sauce simmers and thickens, about 5 minutes. Stir in the salt, pepper and thyme.
Layer one third of the potatoes in the dish, overlapping slightly, and pour one third of the sauce over them. Repeat twice more.
Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 30 to 40 minutes more, until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving, garnished with parsley if using.

recipes.title: French Fries
recipes.description: Homemade double-fried russet fries that are crisp outside and fluffy inside.
steps: Scrub or peel the potatoes and cut them into 1/4-inch-thick sticks.
Soak the potatoes in a large bowl of cold water for at least 30 minutes to remove excess starch, then drain and dry thoroughly with towels.
Heat the oil in a large heavy pot or deep fryer to 325°F.
Fry the potatoes in batches for 5 to 6 minutes, until soft and pale but not browned. Drain on a wire rack and let rest at least 10 minutes.
Raise the oil temperature to 375°F. Fry the potatoes again in batches for 2 to 3 minutes, until deep golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels, toss immediately with the salt and serve hot.

recipes.title: Hash Browns
recipes.description: Crispy shredded potato hash browns cooked in butter and oil in a skillet.
steps: Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes on a box grater.
Rinse the shreds in cold water, then wrap them in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Toss the potatoes with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil and butter in a 12-inch nonstick or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until the butter foams.
Spread the potatoes in an even layer, press down lightly and cook undisturbed until deep golden on the bottom, 6 to 8 minutes.
Flip in sections and cook the other side 5 to 6 minutes more until crisp. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
recipes.description: Classic picnic potato salad with hard-boiled eggs, celery, pickles and a creamy mustard dressing.
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 3/4-inch cubes. Cover with cold water in a large pot, add 1 tablespoon of the salt and bring to a boil. Simmer until just tender, 10 to 12 minutes.
Drain the potatoes, spread them in a large bowl and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the vinegar while warm. Let cool.
Meanwhile, place the eggs in a saucepan, cover with water, bring to a boil, then cover, remove from the heat and let stand 12 minutes. Cool in ice water, peel and chop.
Whisk the mayonnaise, mustard, the remaining 1 tablespoon vinegar, the sugar, the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and the pepper.
Add the diced celery, finely chopped red onion, chopped pickles and eggs to the potatoes, pour the dressing over and fold gently to combine.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Sprinkle with paprika before serving if desired.

recipes.title: Coleslaw
recipes.description: Crisp shredded cabbage and carrots in a tangy, lightly sweet mayonnaise dressing.
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt and pepper until smooth.
Finely shred the cabbage and coarsely grate the carrots.
Add the cabbage, carrots and green onions if using to the dressing and toss until evenly coated.
Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour to let the flavors blend.
Toss again just before serving.

recipes.title: Garden Salad
recipes.description: A simple green salad of romaine, tomato, cucumber, carrot and red onion with a Dijon vinaigrette.
steps: Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, mustard, honey, minced garlic, salt and pepper in a small bowl or shake in a jar.
Wash, dry and chop the romaine into bite-size pieces.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges, slice the cucumber into half-moons, shred the carrots and thinly slice the red onion.
Combine the romaine and vegetables in a large bowl.
Drizzle with the dressing just before serving and toss to coat.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine with homemade garlic croutons, Parmesan and a creamy lemon-garlic Caesar dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cut the bread into 3/4-inch cubes and toss with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil, the garlic powder and 1/4 teaspoon of the salt.
Spread on a baking sheet and bake 12 to 15 minutes, stirring once, until golden and crisp. Let cool.

For the dressing, whisk the mayonnaise, the juice of the lemon (about 3 tablespoons), the grated garlic, mustard, Worcestershire, 1/2 cup of the Parmesan, the pepper and the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Slowly whisk in the remaining 6 tablespoons olive oil until creamy.
Chop the romaine into bite-size pieces and toss in a large bowl with enough dressing to coat.
Top with the croutons and the remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cobb Salad
recipes.description: A hearty composed salad of chicken, bacon, hard-boiled eggs, avocado, tomato and blue cheese over romaine with red wine vinaigrette.
steps: Place the eggs in a saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Cover, remove from the heat and let stand 12 minutes, then cool in ice water, peel and chop.
Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels and crumble.

Season the chicken with 1/2 teaspoon of the salt and 1/4 teaspoon of the pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 5 to 7 minutes per side, until it reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes and dice.
Whisk the remaining 5 tablespoons olive oil with the vinegar, mustard, minced garlic and the remaining salt and pepper.
Chop the romaine and spread it on a large platter. Dice the tomatoes and avocados.
Arrange the chicken, bacon, eggs, tomatoes, avocado and blue cheese in rows over the lettuce and sprinkle with green onions if using.
Drizzle with the vinaigrette at the table and toss before eating.

recipes.title: Chili Mac
recipes.description: A one-pot mash-up of beef chili and macaroni, simmered together and topped with melted cheddar.
steps: In a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, cook the beef and diced onion, breaking up the meat, until browned, about 8 minutes. Drain excess fat.
Add the minced garlic, chili powder, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper and stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the diced tomatoes with their juice, tomato sauce, drained and rinsed kidney beans and broth. Bring to a boil.
Add the macaroni, reduce the heat to medium-low, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 12 to 14 minutes until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed.
Remove from the heat, stir in 1 cup of the cheddar and sprinkle the rest over the top. Cover for 2 minutes to melt.
Serve with sour cream and green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken and Dumplings
recipes.description: Chicken and vegetables simmered in a creamy thickened broth and topped with fluffy drop dumplings.
steps: Melt 3 tablespoons of the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook until softened, about 6 minutes. Add the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in 1/3 cup of the flour and stir 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the broth.
Add the whole chicken thighs, thyme, bay leaf, 1 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove the chicken, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot. Discard the bay leaf and stir in the cream.

For the dumplings, whisk the remaining 2 cups flour, the baking powder, sugar and remaining 1 teaspoon salt. Stir in the milk and the remaining 3 tablespoons butter, melted, just until a thick dough forms.
Bring the stew to a gentle simmer and drop the dough by heaping tablespoons over the surface.
Cover and simmer without lifting the lid for 15 minutes, until the dumplings are puffed and cooked through.
Ladle into bowls and sprinkle with parsley if using.

recipes.title: Biscuits and Gravy
recipes.description: Flaky homemade buttermilk biscuits smothered in a peppery sausage cream gravy.
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk 2 cups of the flour with the baking powder, baking soda, sugar and 1 teaspoon of the salt. Cut in the cold butter until the pieces are the size of peas.
Stir in the cold buttermilk just until a shaggy dough forms. Pat it into a 1-inch-thick rectangle on a floured surface, fold in half, and pat out again.
Cut 8 biscuits with a 2 1/2-inch cutter, pressing straight down without twisting. Place them touching on the baking sheet and bake 12 to 15 minutes until tall and golden.
Meanwhile, brown the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Do not drain.
Sprinkle the remaining 1/3 cup flour over the sausage and stir 1 to 2 minutes to cook the flour.
Slowly pour in the milk, stirring constantly, and simmer 5 to 7 minutes until thick. Season with the pepper and the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Split the warm biscuits and spoon the gravy over them to serve.

recipes.title: Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes made from scratch in about 20 minutes.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the buttermilk, egg, melted butter and vanilla.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined; a few lumps are fine. Let the batter rest 5 minutes.
Heat a griddle or large skillet over medium heat (about 375°F) and brush lightly with oil.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form on top and the edges look set, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more until golden.
Serve warm with maple syrup if desired, oiling the griddle between batches.

recipes.title: Waffles
recipes.description: Crisp, light waffles made with whipped egg whites and melted butter.
steps: Preheat the waffle iron.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Separate the eggs. Whisk the yolks with the milk, melted butter and vanilla, then stir into the dry ingredients just until combined.
Beat the egg whites with a whisk or mixer until they hold stiff peaks, then gently fold them into the batter.
Brush the waffle iron with oil and pour in enough batter to cover about two-thirds of the grid (usually 1/2 to 2/3 cup).
Cook according to the iron's directions, 4 to 5 minutes, until golden and crisp and the steam slows.
Serve right away with maple syrup if desired, or hold on a rack in a 200°F oven while you cook the rest.

recipes.title: French Toast
recipes.description: Bread slices soaked in a cinnamon-vanilla custard and griddled in butter until golden.
steps: In a shallow dish, whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon, vanilla and salt until well blended.
Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat and melt about 1/2 tablespoon of the butter.
Dip each bread slice in the egg mixture for about 5 seconds per side, letting the excess drip off. Day-old bread works best.
Cook the slices 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden brown and set in the center, adding butter between batches.
Serve hot with maple syrup and a dusting of powdered sugar if desired.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs
recipes.description: Soft, creamy scrambled eggs cooked low and slow in butter.
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the milk and salt and whisk until completely blended and slightly frothy.
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat until it foams.
Pour in the eggs and let them sit for about 20 seconds, until they just begin to set at the edges.
Using a silicone spatula, slowly push the eggs from the edges toward the center to form soft curds, stirring every few seconds.
When the eggs are mostly set but still glossy, after 2 to 3 minutes, remove the pan from the heat; they will finish cooking from residual heat.
Season with pepper, sprinkle with green onions if using, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Omelets
recipes.description: Two fluffy French-style omelets filled with diced ham, sautéed pepper and onion, and melted cheddar.
steps: Melt 2 teaspoons of the butter in an 8- or 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook the diced bell pepper and onion until soft, about 4 minutes. Add the diced ham, warm through 1 minute, then transfer to a plate and wipe out the pan.
Whisk 3 of the eggs with half the salt and pepper until no streaks remain.

Melt 2 teaspoons of the butter in the skillet over medium heat. Pour in the eggs and stir gently with a spatula for 20 seconds, then let them set, lifting the edges and tilting the pan so the uncooked egg runs underneath.
When the top is nearly set, about 2 minutes, sprinkle half the cheese and half the filling over one side.
Fold the omelet in half, cook 30 seconds more to melt the cheese, and slide onto a plate.
Repeat with the remaining butter, eggs, seasoning, cheese and filling. Garnish with green onions if using.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burritos
recipes.description: Flour tortillas stuffed with scrambled eggs, crispy potatoes, sausage and cheddar; they freeze well for busy mornings.
steps: Dice the potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add the potatoes with 1/2 teaspoon of the salt, the paprika and garlic powder, cover and cook 8 minutes, then uncover and cook 6 to 8 minutes more, stirring, until crisp and tender. Transfer to a bowl.
In the same skillet, brown the sausage, breaking it up, until cooked through, about 7 minutes. Drain on paper towels.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Melt the butter in the skillet over medium-low heat and scramble the eggs until just set.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 20 to 30 seconds wrapped in a damp towel so they are pliable.
Divide the potatoes, sausage, eggs and cheddar among the tortillas, keeping the filling in the center.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. For a crisp outside, toast seam side down in a dry skillet over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes per side.
Serve with salsa if desired. To freeze, cool completely, wrap individually in foil and freeze up to 3 months; reheat from frozen at 375°F for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Bacon and Eggs
recipes.description: Crisp skillet bacon with eggs fried in the rendered bacon fat.
steps: Lay the bacon in a cold 10- or 12-inch skillet in a single layer.
Turn the heat to medium and cook, turning occasionally, until browned and crisp, 8 to 10 minutes.
Transfer the bacon to a paper-towel-lined plate. Pour off all but about 1 tablespoon of the fat.

Reduce the heat to medium-low and crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the whites are set and the edges are lightly crisp, 2 to 3 minutes for sunny-side up; flip and cook 30 seconds more for over-easy.
Season the eggs with salt and pepper and serve with the bacon.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
recipes.description: A creamy homemade tomato soup served with golden, buttery cheddar grilled cheese sandwiches for dipping.
steps: Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cook the diced onion until soft, about 6 minutes, then add the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the crushed tomatoes, broth, sugar, basil, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer 15 minutes.
Puree the soup until smooth with an immersion blender (or carefully in a blender in batches). Stir in the cream and keep warm over low heat.
Meanwhile, soften the remaining 4 tablespoons butter and spread it on one side of each bread slice.
Slice the cheddar and assemble 4 sandwiches with the buttered sides facing out.
Cook the sandwiches in a large skillet over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until deep golden and the cheese is melted.
Cut the sandwiches in half and serve with bowls of the hot soup.

recipes.title: BLT with Avocado
recipes.description: A classic bacon, lettuce and tomato sandwich on toasted bread with sliced avocado added for creaminess.
steps: Lay the bacon in a cold skillet and cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
While the bacon cooks, slice the tomato into 1/4-inch rounds, separate and dry the romaine leaves, and halve, pit and thinly slice the avocado.
Toast the bread until golden.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each slice of toast.
On two slices, layer the romaine, tomato slices (sprinkled with the salt and pepper), avocado and 3 slices of bacon each.
Top with the remaining toast, mayonnaise side down, cut in half and serve right away.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon
recipes.description: Salmon fillets baked with garlic butter and lemon until just flaky. Ready in about 20 minutes.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with foil or parchment.
Pat the salmon dry, cut it into 4 portions if needed, and place skin side down on the sheet.
Melt the butter and stir in the olive oil, minced garlic, the juice of half the lemon, paprika, salt and pepper.
Brush or spoon the garlic butter evenly over the salmon. Slice the remaining lemon half and lay the slices around the fish.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and the thickest part reaches 145°F.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley if using and serve with the roasted lemon slices.

recipes.title: Fish Tacos
recipes.description: Spice-rubbed pan-seared cod in warm corn tortillas with crunchy cabbage and a creamy lime sauce.
steps: Stir together the sour cream, mayonnaise, sriracha and the juice of 1 lime to make the sauce. Cut the second lime into wedges.
Thinly slice the cabbage.
Pat the cod dry. Mix the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika and salt, and rub it over both sides of the fish.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the cod for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until opaque and it flakes easily (145°F). Break into large chunks.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for about 30 seconds per side, or wrap in damp paper towels and microwave for 30 seconds.
Fill each tortilla with fish, cabbage and a drizzle of sauce. Top with cilantro and sliced avocado if using, and serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Fish and Chips
recipes.description: Crispy beer-battered cod with double-fried potato chips and a quick homemade tartar sauce.
steps: Make the tartar sauce: finely chop the pickles and stir them into the mayonnaise with 1 teaspoon lemon juice. Refrigerate. Cut the rest of the lemon into wedges.
Peel the potatoes and cut into 1/2-inch-thick sticks. Soak in cold water for 30 minutes, then drain and dry thoroughly on towels.
Heat the oil in a large heavy pot or deep fryer to 325°F. Fry the potatoes in batches for 5 to 6 minutes, until soft but still pale. Drain on a rack.
Cut the cod into 4 to 6 pieces and pat very dry. Season with 1/2 teaspoon of the salt and dredge lightly in 1/4 cup of the flour.
Whisk the remaining 1 cup flour, baking powder, paprika and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a bowl. Whisk in the cold beer just until smooth.

Raise the oil temperature to 375°F. Dip the fish in the batter, let the excess drip off, and lower carefully into the oil. Fry 2 or 3 pieces at a time for 4 to 6 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and the fish reaches 145°F. Drain on a rack.
Return the potatoes to the 375°F oil in batches for 2 to 3 minutes, until crisp and golden. Drain and toss with the remaining salt.
Serve the fish and chips hot with tartar sauce and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.description: Shrimp sautéed in garlic, butter, lemon and a splash of broth, tossed with spaghetti.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Meanwhile, peel and devein the shrimp if needed, pat dry and season with the salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil and 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, just until pink. Transfer to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium, add the minced garlic and red pepper flakes, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the broth and the juice of the lemon and simmer for 2 minutes, scraping up any browned bits. Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons butter.
Add the spaghetti, shrimp and parsley and toss, adding splashes of pasta water as needed to make a glossy sauce.
Serve immediately, topped with Parmesan if desired.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
recipes.description: Large shrimp seared in a skillet with plenty of garlic, butter and lemon. Serve over rice or with bread.
steps: Peel and devein the shrimp if needed and pat them very dry. Toss with the paprika, salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil and 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until pink on the bottom. Flip.

Add the remaining 3 tablespoons butter, the minced garlic and red pepper flakes if using. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, stirring, until the shrimp are pink and opaque throughout and the garlic is fragrant but not browned.
Remove from the heat and squeeze in the juice of half the lemon. Cut the other half into wedges.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the pan sauce and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Crisp-tender broccoli, peppers, carrots and mushrooms in a garlicky soy-ginger sauce, served over jasmine rice.
steps: Rinse the jasmine rice until the water runs mostly clear. Combine it with 2 1/4 cups water in a saucepan and bring to a boil, then cover, reduce the heat to low and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and let stand, covered, for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Cut the broccoli into small florets, slice the bell pepper into strips, thinly slice the carrots on the diagonal and the mushrooms, and slice the green onions. Mince the garlic and grate the ginger.
Whisk the soy sauce, broth, honey, rice vinegar, cornstarch and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add the carrots and broccoli and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and mushrooms and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes more, until the vegetables are crisp-tender.
Push the vegetables aside, add the garlic, ginger and white parts of the green onions to the center and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir the sauce, pour it in and toss for about 1 minute until it thickens and coats the vegetables.
Serve over the rice, topped with the green onion tops and sesame seeds if using.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
recipes.description: Takeout-style fried rice made with cold leftover rice, scrambled egg, peas and carrots.
steps: Combine the rice and 2 1/4 cups water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low and cook for 18 minutes, then let stand off the heat for 5 minutes and fluff. Spread it on a sheet pan and refrigerate until cold, ideally overnight (you should have about 4 1/2 cups cooked rice).
Dice the onion and carrot, mince the garlic and slice the green onions. Beat the eggs.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Scramble the eggs until just set, then transfer to a plate and chop.
Add 1 tablespoon oil, the onion and carrot and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the peas and garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the remaining oil and the cold rice, breaking up clumps. Spread it out and let it sit for 1 minute to toast, then stir. Repeat for 3 to 4 minutes until the rice is hot.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, pepper, eggs and green onions and toss to combine. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: Fried rice with tender bites of chicken, egg and vegetables, made with day-old rice for the best texture.
steps: Combine the rice and 2 1/4 cups water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low and cook for 18 minutes, then let stand off the heat for 5 minutes and fluff. Spread it on a sheet pan and refrigerate until cold, ideally overnight (you should have about 4 1/2 cups cooked rice).
Cut the chicken into 1/2-inch pieces and season with the salt and pepper. Dice the onion and carrot, mince the garlic, slice the green onions and beat the eggs.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, until browned and cooked through to 165°F. Transfer to a plate.
Add 1 teaspoon of the oil and scramble the eggs until just set. Add them to the chicken.
Add 1 tablespoon oil, the onion and carrot and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the peas and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the remaining oil (about 2 teaspoons) and the cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until hot and lightly toasted.
Return the chicken and eggs to the pan with the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions. Toss until evenly coated and serve hot.

recipes.title: Homemade Pizza
recipes.description: Two 12-inch pepperoni pizzas on a simple homemade yeast crust, baked in a very hot oven.
steps: Stir the yeast (1 packet, 2 1/4 teaspoons) and sugar into 1 cup warm water (about 110°F) and let stand 5 minutes until foamy.
In a large bowl, mix the flour and salt. Add the yeast mixture and 2 tablespoons of the olive oil and stir into a shaggy dough.
Knead on a lightly floured surface for 6 to 8 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise in a warm spot for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until doubled.
