Place a pizza stone or upside-down baking sheet on the lower rack and heat the oven to 500°F for at least 30 minutes.
Punch down the dough and divide it in half. Stretch each piece into a 12-inch round on a cornmeal-dusted pizza peel or sheet of parchment.
Brush the edges with the remaining olive oil. Spread each crust with 1/2 cup marinara, leaving a 1/2-inch border, then top with half the mozzarella, half the pepperoni and a pinch of oregano.
Slide the pizza onto the hot stone and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the crust is deep golden and the cheese is bubbling and browned in spots. Repeat with the second pizza.
Sprinkle with Parmesan if using, let rest 2 minutes, then slice and serve.

recipes.title: BBQ Ribs
recipes.description: Dry-rubbed baby back ribs baked low and slow until tender, then glazed with barbecue sauce on the grill.
steps: Heat the oven to 275°F. Pat the ribs dry and pull off the thin membrane from the bone side using a paper towel for grip.
Mix the brown sugar, smoked paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper and cayenne. Rub it all over both sides of the ribs.
Wrap each rack tightly in heavy-duty foil, meat side up, and set on a rimmed baking sheet.
Bake for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, until the meat is very tender and pulling back from the ends of the bones (about 195°F to 203°F between the bones).
Heat a grill to medium (about 350°F to 400°F). Carefully unwrap the ribs and brush both sides with barbecue sauce.
Grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning and basting with more sauce every few minutes, until the sauce is sticky and lightly charred. (Or broil on high for 3 to 5 minutes.)
Rest for 5 minutes, then cut between the bones and serve with any remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Corn on the Cob
recipes.description: Sweet corn boiled until just tender and brushed with butter. A simple summer side dish.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Husk the corn and pull off the silk. Break or cut large ears in half if needed to fit the pot.
Add the corn to the boiling water, return to a boil and cook for 4 to 6 minutes, until the kernels are bright yellow and tender when pierced.
Meanwhile, melt the butter.
Lift the corn out with tongs, let drain briefly, and brush with the melted butter. Sprinkle with salt, plus pepper and chopped parsley if using, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
recipes.description: Classic deli-style macaroni salad with a tangy, creamy dressing, celery, bell pepper and red onion.
steps: Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water until just tender, 1 minute past al dente. Drain, rinse under cold water until cool, and drain well.
Finely dice the celery, bell pepper, red onion and pickles.
In a large bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt and pepper. Set aside about 1/4 cup of the dressing in a small covered container in the refrigerator.
Add the macaroni and vegetables and stir until evenly coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour so the flavors blend. The pasta absorbs dressing as it sits, so stir in the reserved dressing just before serving.
Sprinkle with paprika if using and serve cold. Keeps refrigerated up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
recipes.description: Hard-cooked egg halves filled with a creamy, tangy yolk mixture and dusted with paprika.
steps: Place the eggs in a saucepan, cover with cold water by 1 inch and bring to a boil over high heat.
As soon as it boils, cover, remove from the heat and let stand for 12 minutes.
Transfer the eggs to a bowl of ice water for 10 minutes, then peel.
Halve the eggs lengthwise and pop the yolks into a bowl. Mash the yolks with a fork until fine.
Stir in the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper until smooth.
Spoon or pipe the filling into the egg whites, sprinkle with paprika if using, and serve or refrigerate up to 1 day.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.description: A moist, easy quick bread made with very ripe bananas and melted butter, no mixer needed.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl until mostly smooth. Melt the butter and stir it in.
Stir in the granulated sugar, brown sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle the baking soda, salt and cinnamon over the batter and stir in, then add the flour and stir just until no dry streaks remain. Fold in chopped walnuts if using.
Scrape into the pan and bake for 55 to 65 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Classic chewy chocolate chip cookies with crisp edges, made with butter and both white and brown sugar.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the softened butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar and vanilla with a mixer on medium speed for 2 to 3 minutes, until light and creamy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time.
Gradually mix in the flour mixture on low speed just until combined, then stir in the chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough 2 inches apart on the baking sheets.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are golden and the centers look just set.
Cool on the sheets for 2 minutes, then move to a wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.title: Brownies
recipes.description: Fudgy one-bowl cocoa brownies with a crackly top, baked in an 8-inch square pan.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking pan or line it with parchment.
Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over low heat. Remove from the heat and stir in the sugar.
Whisk in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder just until combined. Fold in the chocolate chips if using.
Spread the batter evenly in the pan.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the edges are set and a toothpick in the center comes out with moist crumbs, not wet batter.
Cool completely in the pan on a rack before cutting into 16 squares.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
recipes.description: A double-crust apple pie with an all-butter crust and a cinnamon-spiced filling of sliced fresh apples.
steps: Make the crust: whisk the flour and 1 teaspoon of the salt in a large bowl. Cut the cold butter into cubes and work it in with a pastry cutter or your fingers until the pieces are the size of peas.
Drizzle in 6 to 8 tablespoons ice water, a tablespoon at a time, tossing until the dough holds together when squeezed. Divide in half, shape into two disks, wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 425°F with a rack in the lowest position. Peel, core and slice the apples 1/4 inch thick (about 3 pounds; about 8 cups).
Toss the apples with the granulated sugar, brown sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, nutmeg, remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
Roll one disk into a 12-inch circle and fit it into a 9-inch pie plate. Add the filling, mounding it in the center.
Roll out the second disk, lay it over the filling, trim to a 1-inch overhang, fold under and crimp the edges. Cut 4 or 5 vents in the top.
Beat the egg with 1 tablespoon water and brush it over the top crust. Set the pie on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes, then lower the oven to 375°F and bake 35 to 45 minutes more, until the crust is deep golden and the juices bubble through the vents. Tent with foil if the edges brown too fast.
Cool on a rack for at least 3 hours so the filling sets before slicing.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: A moist two-layer chocolate cake made with cocoa and covered in a creamy chocolate buttercream.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease two 9-inch round cake pans and line the bottoms with parchment.
In a large bowl, whisk the granulated sugar, flour, 3/4 cup of the cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add the eggs, 1 cup of the milk, the oil and 2 teaspoons of the vanilla. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes.
Stir in 1 cup boiling water; the batter will be thin. Divide between the pans.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then turn out onto racks and cool completely.

Make the frosting: melt the butter and stir in the remaining 3/4 cup cocoa. Alternately beat in the powdered sugar and the remaining 1/3 cup milk until smooth and spreadable, then beat in the remaining 1 teaspoon vanilla. Add a little more milk if too thick.
Place one layer on a plate, spread with about 3/4 cup frosting, top with the second layer, and frost the top and sides.

recipes.title: Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
recipes.description: Spaghetti tossed with a hearty ground beef and tomato sauce simmered with garlic and Italian herbs.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Add the ground beef, raise the heat to medium-high and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink. Spoon off excess fat.
Stir in the minced garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.

Add the crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, sugar, salt, pepper and red pepper flakes if using. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and simmer partially covered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
About 15 minutes before the sauce is done, cook the spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Toss the spaghetti with about half of the sauce, loosening with pasta water if needed. Serve topped with the remaining sauce and Parmesan if desired.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: A hearty tomato-based soup of tender beef chunks, potatoes, green beans, carrots and corn.
steps: Pat the beef dry, cut any large pieces into 1-inch cubes, and season with 1/2 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef in two batches, about 5 minutes per batch, and transfer to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium. Add the diced onion, sliced carrots and celery and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the broth, tomatoes with their juice, Worcestershire, thyme, bay leaves and the beef with its juices. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 1 hour.
Add the potatoes, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes, and the green beans, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the beef and potatoes are tender.
Stir in the corn and the remaining salt and cook for 5 minutes. Remove the bay leaves, adjust seasoning and serve.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
recipes.description: A thick, creamy soup of tender broccoli and sharp cheddar, like the bakery-café favorite.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.
Slowly whisk in the broth, then the half and half. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring, until slightly thickened.
Add the broccoli, cut into small florets, and the carrot, grated or cut into thin matchsticks. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the broccoli is tender.
For a thicker soup, blend about a third of it with an immersion blender, or blend a portion in a blender and return it to the pot.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the shredded cheddar a handful at a time until melted. Do not let it boil. Season with the salt, pepper and nutmeg and serve.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
recipes.description: Creamy, comforting potato soup with onion and celery, partly mashed for a thick, chunky texture.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion and celery and cook for 6 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour and cook, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes.
Gradually whisk in the broth until smooth.
Peel the potatoes and cut into 3/4-inch cubes. Add them with the thyme, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered for 15 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are very tender.
Mash some of the potatoes in the pot with a potato masher until the soup is as thick as you like.
Stir in the milk and heat through without boiling. Taste and adjust seasoning, and serve topped with sliced green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: A light, brothy soup loaded with carrots, celery, potatoes, green beans, zucchini, tomatoes and corn.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes, the green beans cut into 1-inch pieces, the tomatoes with their juice, broth, Italian seasoning, bay leaf, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer partly covered for 15 minutes.
Add the diced zucchini and corn and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes more, until all the vegetables are tender.
Remove the bay leaf, adjust the seasoning and serve sprinkled with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
recipes.description: A spiced tomato and chicken broth soup with shredded chicken, black beans and corn, topped with crisp baked tortilla strips.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Cut the tortillas into thin strips, toss with 1 tablespoon of the oil and a pinch of the salt, and spread on a baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring once, until crisp and golden.
Heat the remaining oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion and seeded, minced jalapeño and cook for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin and oregano and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and remaining salt and bring to a boil.
Add the whole chicken breasts, reduce the heat and simmer gently for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove the chicken, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot with the drained, rinsed black beans and the corn. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the juice of the lime and the chopped cilantro.
Ladle into bowls and top with tortilla strips, plus diced avocado and shredded cheese if using.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
recipes.description: Deeply caramelized onions simmered in beef broth, topped with toasted baguette and melted Swiss cheese.
steps: Halve the onions and slice them thinly (you should have about 10 cups).
Melt the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the onions, sugar and salt and stir to coat.
Cook, stirring every few minutes and lowering the heat if they start to scorch, for 45 to 60 minutes, until the onions are soft and deep golden brown.
Stir in the minced garlic for 1 minute, then sprinkle in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the broth, scraping up the browned bits. Add the thyme, bay leaf, Worcestershire and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Remove the bay leaf and adjust the salt.
Meanwhile, toast the baguette slices on a baking sheet at 400°F for 5 to 7 minutes until crisp.
Heat the broiler. Set 6 oven-safe bowls on a rimmed baking sheet, ladle in the soup, float 2 toasts in each and cover with the cheese.
Broil 6 inches from the heat for 2 to 4 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and browned in spots. Serve carefully, as the bowls will be very hot.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
recipes.description: New England-style creamy clam chowder with bacon, potatoes and tender chopped clams.
steps: Drain three 6.5-ounce cans of chopped clams, reserving the juice (about 1 1/2 cups).
Cook the chopped bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crisp, about 6 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon, leaving the fat in the pot.
Add the butter, diced onion and celery and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Slowly whisk in the reserved clam juice and the broth until smooth.
Add the potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes, plus the thyme, bay leaf and pepper. Simmer, partly covered, for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the half and half and the clams and heat gently for 5 minutes without boiling, so the clams stay tender.
Remove the bay leaf, add salt to taste and serve topped with the bacon, parsley and crackers if desired.

recipes.title: Split Pea Soup
recipes.description: A thick, meatless split pea soup with carrots and celery and a little smoked paprika for smoky flavor.
steps: Rinse the split peas and pick out any debris.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the split peas, broth, 2 cups water, thyme and bay leaf. Bring to a boil, skimming off any foam.
Reduce the heat, cover partly and simmer for 60 to 75 minutes, stirring occasionally so the peas don't stick, until they have broken down and the soup is thick.
Remove the bay leaf. For a smoother soup, purée part or all of it with an immersion blender.
Season with the salt and pepper, thinning with a little water if it is too thick, and serve. The soup thickens further as it cools.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
recipes.description: An Italian vegetable soup with beans, small pasta and greens in a tomato broth.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, 1 cup water, Italian seasoning, bay leaf, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the diced zucchini, green beans cut into 1-inch pieces, and the drained, rinsed kidney beans. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the macaroni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Remove the bay leaf and adjust the seasoning.
Serve topped with Parmesan and torn basil if desired. The pasta keeps absorbing broth, so add water when reheating leftovers.

recipes.title: Cream of Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: A silky homemade mushroom soup with butter, thyme and cream, far better than the canned kind.
steps: Slice the mushrooms and dice the onion.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, for 8 to 10 minutes, until they release their liquid and begin to brown.
Add the onion, garlic, thyme and salt and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the onion is soft.
Sprinkle in the flour and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Gradually stir in the broth.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.
Blend about half the soup with an immersion blender, leaving some mushroom pieces for texture.
Stir in the cream and pepper and heat through without boiling. Serve sprinkled with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Wild Rice Soup
recipes.description: A creamy Minnesota-style soup with chicken, nutty wild rice, carrots and celery.
steps: Rinse the wild rice in a strainer.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Slowly whisk in the broth until smooth.
Add the wild rice, whole chicken breasts, thyme, bay leaf, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low.
After 20 to 25 minutes, when the chicken reaches 165°F, remove it, shred it and set it aside.
Continue simmering, covered, for 25 to 35 minutes more, until the wild rice is tender and some grains have split open.
Return the chicken, stir in the half and half and heat through without boiling. Remove the bay leaf, adjust the seasoning and garnish with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Corn Chowder
recipes.description: A thick, creamy chowder of chicken, sweet corn, potatoes and bacon with a hint of smoked paprika.
steps: Cook the chopped bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crisp, about 6 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon, leaving the fat.
Add the butter, diced onion, celery and bell pepper and cook for 6 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the broth.
Add the potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes, the chicken cut into 3/4-inch pieces, thyme, smoked paprika, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 to 18 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and the chicken is cooked through to 165°F.
Add the corn and half and half and simmer gently for 5 minutes. For a thicker chowder, mash some of the potatoes against the side of the pot.
Serve topped with the bacon and sliced green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Soup
recipes.description: Tender chicken thighs and vegetables in a velvety, lightly creamy broth.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Slowly whisk in the broth until smooth.
Add the whole chicken thighs, thyme, bay leaf, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then simmer gently, partly covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken (it should read at least 175°F), shred it and set aside.
Add the potato, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes, and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until tender.
Return the chicken and add the peas and cream. Heat for 5 minutes without boiling.
Remove the bay leaf, adjust the seasoning and serve sprinkled with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Soup
recipes.description: A smooth, rich tomato soup made with canned tomatoes, a little cream and basil. Great with grilled cheese.
steps: Heat the butter and olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the minced garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes, broth, sugar, dried basil, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Purée the soup until smooth with an immersion blender, or carefully in batches in a blender with the lid vented.
Stir in the cream and heat through. Adjust the seasoning.
Serve topped with torn fresh basil if desired.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
recipes.description: Thick, creamy potato soup made from baked potatoes and topped like a loaded potato with bacon, cheddar, sour cream and green onions.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Scrub the potatoes, prick them several times with a fork and bake directly on the rack for 55 to 65 minutes, until tender. Let cool slightly.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crisp. Drain on paper towels, crumble, and pour off all but 1 tablespoon of the fat.
Add the butter and diced onion to the pot and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then the flour, and cook for 2 minutes.
Gradually whisk in the broth and milk. Bring to a simmer, stirring, until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Peel the potatoes (or leave the skins on for more texture), cut into chunks and add to the pot. Mash with a potato masher to the consistency you like and simmer for 5 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in 1/2 cup of the sour cream, 1 cup of the shredded cheddar, the salt and pepper until the cheese melts. Do not boil.
Ladle into bowls and top with the remaining cheese and sour cream, the bacon and sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Ham and Bean Soup
recipes.description: A hearty, old-fashioned soup of navy beans slow-simmered with a smoky ham hock and vegetables.
steps: Rinse and sort the beans, cover with several inches of cold water and soak overnight. Drain and rinse.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the beans, ham hock, broth, 4 cups water, bay leaves, thyme and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat, cover partly and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until the beans are very tender.
Remove the ham hock and let it cool slightly. Pull the meat from the bone, discarding the skin, fat and bone, and chop it.
Mash about 1 cup of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the soup, then return the ham.
Remove the bay leaves. Taste and add salt only as needed, since the ham is salty, and serve.

recipes.title: Navy Bean Soup
recipes.description: A creamy, bacon-flavored navy bean soup with carrots, celery and a touch of tomato, finished with spinach.
steps: Quick-soak the beans: rinse and sort them, cover with 2 inches of water in a large pot, boil for 2 minutes, then cover, remove from the heat and let stand 1 hour. Drain and rinse.
In the same pot, cook the chopped bacon over medium heat until crisp, about 6 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon, leaving the fat.
Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans, broth, thyme and bay leaf. Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until the beans are creamy and tender.
Remove the bay leaf. Blend about a quarter of the soup with an immersion blender or mash some beans to thicken it.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the bacon and pepper. Taste before adding the salt, since the broth and bacon are already salty. Serve sprinkled with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A hearty, healthy soup of brown lentils, vegetables and tomatoes, brightened with lemon and spinach.
steps: Rinse the lentils and pick out any debris.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, cumin and thyme and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the lentils, tomatoes with their juice, broth, bay leaf, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer partly covered for 25 to 30 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Remove the bay leaf. For a thicker soup, blend about a quarter of it with an immersion blender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and the juice of the lemon. Adjust the seasoning and serve.

recipes.title: Split Pea and Ham Soup
recipes.description: Classic thick split pea soup simmered with a smoked ham hock until the peas melt down.
steps: Rinse the split peas and pick out any debris.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the split peas, ham hock, broth, 4 cups water, thyme, bay leaf and pepper. Bring to a boil, skimming off any foam.
Reduce the heat, cover partly and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally so the peas don't stick, until the peas have broken down and the ham is tender.
Remove the ham hock and bay leaf. When cool enough to handle, pull the meat from the bone, discard the skin, fat and bone, and chop the meat.
Stir the ham back into the soup. Thin with water if needed, add salt only as needed, and serve.

recipes.title: Beef Barley Soup
recipes.description: Tender beef, mushrooms and chewy pearl barley in a rich, savory beef broth.
steps: Pat the beef dry, cut into 3/4-inch pieces and season with 1/2 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef in two batches, about 5 minutes per batch. Transfer to a plate.
Add the diced onion, carrots, celery and sliced mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes, until the mushrooms have browned. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the broth, Worcestershire, thyme, bay leaves and the beef with its juices, scraping up the browned bits. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 1 hour.
Stir in the rinsed barley and simmer, covered, for 40 to 45 minutes more, until the barley and beef are tender. Add water if the soup gets too thick.
Remove the bay leaves, add the remaining salt to taste and serve sprinkled with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Italian Wedding Soup
recipes.description: Tender little beef and pork meatballs simmered in chicken broth with orzo, vegetables and spinach.
steps: In a bowl, combine the ground beef, ground pork, breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup of the Parmesan, the egg, 1 clove of the garlic (minced), the parsley, 1/2 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper. Mix gently with your hands until just combined.
Roll the mixture into 1-inch meatballs (about 50) and set them on a sheet pan.
Dice the onion, carrots and celery and mince the remaining 2 cloves of garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until softened. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds more.
Pour in the chicken brothand bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce to a steady simmer and gently drop in the meatballs. Simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in the orzo.
Simmer for 8 to 10 minutes more, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is tender and the meatballs reach an internal temperature of 160°F.
Stir in the spinach and cook 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. Taste and add up to the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt only if needed; the broth and Parmesan are already salty.
Ladle into bowls and top each serving with some of the remaining 1/2 cup Parmesan.

recipes.title: Sausage and Bean Soup
recipes.description: A hearty Italian sausage soup with white beans, tomatoes and kale that comes together on the stovetop in under an hour.
steps: Remove the sausage from its casings. Dice the onion, carrots and celery, and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans. Strip the kale leaves from the stems and chop them.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the sausage and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it into small pieces, until browned and no longer pink.
Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, Italian seasoning and red pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds.
Add the diced tomatoes with their juices, the chicken broth and the beans. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the kale and simmer 5 to 7 minutes more until tender. Season with the salt and pepper.
Serve hot, sprinkled with Parmesan if you like.

recipes.title: Sausage Potato Soup
recipes.description: A creamy Tuscan-style soup with Italian sausage, bacon, sliced potatoes and kale.
steps: Remove the sausage from its casings. Chop the bacon, dice the onion and mince the garlic. Scrub the potatoes, halve them lengthwise and slice 1/4 inch thick. Strip and chop the kale.
Cook the bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crisp, about 6 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the fat in the pot.

Add the sausage and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through. Spoon off all but 1 tablespoon of the fat, then add the onion and cook 4 minutes, then the garlic and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken broth and potatoes. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 15 to 18 minutes until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Stir in the cream and kale and simmer gently for 5 minutes until the kale is tender; do not let it boil hard. Season with the salt and pepper.
Ladle into bowls and top with the bacon and Parmesan if using.

recipes.title: Creamy Sausage Tortellini Soup
recipes.description: Cheese tortellini, Italian sausage and spinach in a creamy tomato broth.
steps: Remove the sausage from its casings, dice the onion and mince the garlic.
In a large pot over medium-high heat, cook the sausage for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and no longer pink. Spoon off all but 1 tablespoon of fat.
Add the onion and cook 4 to 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic and Italian seasoning and cook 30 seconds.
Add the diced tomatoes with their juices and the chicken broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the tortellini and cook according to the package time, usually 7 to 9 minutes, until tender.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cream, spinach and 1/4 cup of the Parmesan. Cook 2 minutes until the spinach wilts. Season with the salt and pepper.
Serve topped with the remaining Parmesan.

recipes.title: Vegetable Beef Soup
recipes.description: Slow-simmered beef chunks with potatoes, carrots, green beans, corn and peas in a tomato-beef broth.
steps: Pat the beef dry, cut any large pieces into 1-inch cubes and season with 1 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper. Dice the onion, carrots and celery, mince the garlic, peel and cube the potatoes, and cut the green beans into 1-inch pieces.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef in two batches, 4 to 5 minutes per batch, and transfer to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium, add the onion, carrots and celery and cook 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Return the beef and add the beef broth, diced tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, thyme and bay leaves, scraping up the browned bits. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 1 hour.
Add the potatoes and green beans and simmer, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes until the beef and potatoes are tender.
Stir in the corn and peas and cook 5 minutes more. Remove the bay leaves, taste and season with up to the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and serve hot.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
recipes.description: A dump-and-simmer soup of ground beef, beans, corn, tomatoes and green chiles with taco seasoning.
steps: Dice the onion. Drain and rinse the black and pinto beans and drain the corn.
In a large pot over medium-high heat, cook the ground beef and onion for 8 to 10 minutes, breaking up the meat, until browned and no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and cook 1 minute.
Add the beans, corn, diced tomatoes with their juices, green chiles and beef broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Shred the cheddar and slice the green onions while the soup simmers.
Ladle into bowls and top with cheddar, sour cream, green onions and crushed tortilla chips as desired.

recipes.title: White Chicken Chili
recipes.description: Chicken and white beans simmered with green chiles and cumin, finished with cream cheese and Monterey Jack.
steps: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and seed and finely chop the jalapeño. Drain and rinse the beans. Cube the cream cheese and shred the Monterey Jack.

Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and jalapeño for 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic, green chiles, cumin, oregano, chili powder, salt and pepper and cook 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and the whole chicken breasts. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and shred it with two forks.
Mash 1 cup of the beans with a fork and add them to the pot along with the remaining whole beans. Simmer 10 minutes to thicken.
Stir in the shredded chicken, cream cheese and Monterey Jack and stir over low heat until melted and creamy. Squeeze in the juice of the lime and adjust the salt.
Serve topped with cilantro and sour cream if desired.

recipes.title: Black Bean Soup
recipes.description: A thick, smoky-spiced black bean soup, partly blended for body and brightened with lime.
steps: Dice the onion, carrots, celery and bell pepper. Seed and mince the jalapeño and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the black beans.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrots, celery, bell pepper and jalapeño and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, chili powder and oregano and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the beans, vegetable broth, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes.
Blend about half of the soup with an immersion blender (or puree 3 cups in a blender, venting the lid, and return it to the pot) so the soup is thick but still has whole beans.
Stir in the juice of the lime and adjust the seasoning.
Serve topped with a spoonful of sour cream and chopped cilantro if desired.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Soup
recipes.description: A smooth, lightly spiced butternut squash soup finished with a little cream.
steps: Peel, seed and cut the squash into 1-inch cubes (a 3-pound squash gives about 6 cups). Dice the onion, slice the carrots and mince the garlic.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrots and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the onion is soft. Add the garlic, thyme, nutmeg and cinnamon and cook 30 seconds.
Add the squash, vegetable broth, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until the squash is very tender when pierced with a fork.
Puree the soup until completely smooth with an immersion blender, or in batches in a blender with the lid vented.
Stir in the cream and warm over low heat for 2 minutes. Thin with up to 1/2 cup water if it is too thick and adjust the salt before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken and Rice Soup
recipes.description: A light, homey soup of tender shredded chicken, vegetables and long-grain rice in chicken broth.
steps: Dice the onion, slice the carrots and celery, mince the garlic and chop the parsley.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 to 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and thyme and cook 30 seconds.

Add the chicken broth, bay leaf, 1/2 teaspoon of the salt, the pepper and the whole chicken thighs. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Remove the chicken to a cutting board. Stir the rice into the simmering soup, cover and cook for 15 to 18 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, shred the chicken with two forks.
Return the chicken to the pot, discard the bay leaf, and stir in the parsley. Add a squeeze of lemon juice if you like, taste and add up to the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt if needed, then serve.

recipes.title: Cheesecake
recipes.description: A classic New York-style cheesecake with a graham cracker crust, baked gently in a water bath for a smooth, crack-free top.
steps: Set the cream cheese, sour cream and eggs out for about 1 hour to reach room temperature. Heat the oven to 325°F and wrap the outside of a 9-inch springform pan in two layers of heavy-duty foil.

Crush the graham crackers into fine crumbs (about 1 1/2 cups). Melt the butter and stir it into the crumbs with 2 tablespoons of the sugar. Press firmly into the bottom of the pan and bake for 10 minutes. Let cool while you make the filling.
Beat the cream cheese with an electric mixer on medium-low speed until smooth, about 2 minutes, scraping the bowl. Beat in the remaining 1 cup sugar, the flour and the salt until combined.
Beat in the sour cream and vanilla, then the eggs one at a time on low speed, mixing just until each disappears. Do not overbeat.
Pour the filling over the crust. Set the springform pan in a roasting pan and pour in hot water to come 1 inch up the sides.
Bake for 65 to 75 minutes, until the edges are set and the center jiggles slightly when the pan is nudged (about 150°F in the center).
Turn off the oven, prop the door open a few inches and leave the cheesecake inside for 1 hour. Remove from the water bath, run a thin knife around the edge and cool completely on a rack.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight before removing the ring and slicing with a hot, wiped knife.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
recipes.description: A moist spiced carrot cake with walnuts, baked in a 9x13 pan and topped with cream cheese frosting.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease and flour a 9x13-inch baking pan. Set the cream cheese and butter out to soften. Finely grate the carrots (about 1 pound) and chop the walnuts.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt in a bowl.

In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, oil, granulated sugar, brown sugar and 2 teaspoons of the vanilla until smooth. Stir in the flour mixture just until combined, then fold in the carrots, walnuts and raisins if using.
Spread the batter in the pan and bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool completely in the pan on a rack, about 2 hours.
For the frosting, beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Beat in the powdered sugar a cup at a time, then the remaining 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Spread the frosting over the cooled cake. Refrigerate leftovers, covered.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
recipes.description: Southern-style layered banana pudding with homemade vanilla custard, vanilla wafers, sliced bananas and whipped cream.
steps: Separate the eggs and save the whites for another use. In a medium saucepan, whisk the sugar, cornstarch and salt, then whisk in the egg yolks and milk until smooth.

Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, for 8 to 10 minutes until the custard thickens and begins to bubble. Cook 1 minute more, then remove from the heat and stir in the butter and 2 teaspoons of the vanilla.
Transfer the custard to a bowl, press plastic wrap onto the surface and let it cool for 30 minutes.
Slice the bananas 1/4 inch thick. Set aside 6 wafers for garnish. In a 3-quart dish, layer one third of the remaining wafers, one third of the bananas and one third of the custard. Repeat twice more.
Whip the cream, powdered sugar and remaining 1 teaspoon vanilla to stiff peaks and spread it over the pudding.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, until the wafers soften, before serving. Crush the reserved wafers and sprinkle them over the top just before serving.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
recipes.description: Juicy cinnamon-spiced peaches baked under a buttery drop-biscuit topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Peel, pit and slice the peaches (about 3 pounds, 6 cups). In a large bowl, toss them with 1/2 cup of the granulated sugar, the brown sugar, cornstarch, juice of the half lemon, cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla. Spread in the baking dish.

In another bowl, whisk the flour, 7 tablespoons of the remaining sugar, the baking powder and salt. Cut the cold butter into small pieces and rub it in with your fingertips until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in the milk just until a soft, sticky dough forms.
Drop the dough in spoonfuls over the peaches, leaving gaps for steam, and sprinkle with the last 1 tablespoon of sugar.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the topping is golden and the fruit is bubbling thickly around the edges.
Cool for at least 20 minutes before serving warm, plain or with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
recipes.description: Tender cinnamon apples baked under a crunchy brown sugar and oat topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and butter a 9-inch square or 2-quart baking dish.
Peel, core and slice the apples 1/4 inch thick (about 7 cups). Toss with the granulated sugar, cornstarch, 1 teaspoon of the cinnamon and the juice of the half lemon. Spread in the dish.
In a bowl, combine the flour, oats, brown sugar, salt and remaining 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Melt the butter, pour it over and stir until clumpy crumbs form.
Scatter the topping evenly over the apples.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the topping is deep golden and the apples are bubbling and tender when pierced with a knife. Cover loosely with foil if the top browns too quickly.
Let cool 15 minutes before serving warm.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake
recipes.description: Tender homemade cream biscuits split and filled with sugared strawberries and whipped cream.
steps: Hull and slice the strawberries and toss with 1/4 cup of the granulated sugar. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes to release their juices.
Heat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.

Whisk the flour, 3 tablespoons of the granulated sugar, the baking powder and salt. Cut the cold butter into small pieces and work it in with a pastry cutter or your fingertips until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in 3/4 cup of the cream until a shaggy dough forms. Pat it 3/4 inch thick on a floured surface and cut 8 rounds with a 2 1/2-inch cutter, re-patting the scraps once.
Place on the baking sheet, brush the tops with a little cream and sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon sugar. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes until golden. Cool 10 minutes.
Whip the remaining cream (about 1 1/2 cups) with the powdered sugar and vanilla to soft peaks.
Split each biscuit, spoon strawberries and juice over the bottom half, add a dollop of whipped cream and set the top half on.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
recipes.description: Tangy lemon custard baked over a buttery shortbread crust and dusted with powdered sugar.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment, leaving an overhang on two sides.
For the crust, mix 2 cups of the flour, 1/2 cup of the granulated sugar and the salt. Melt the butter, stir it in until a soft dough forms, and press evenly into the pan.
Bake the crust for 18 to 20 minutes, until lightly golden at the edges.

Meanwhile, zest 2 of the lemons to get about 1 tablespoon zest, then juice all 4 to get about 2/3 cup. Whisk the eggs with the remaining 1 1/2 cups sugar and 1/4 cup flour until smooth, then whisk in the lemon juice and zest.
Pour the filling over the hot crust and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the filling is set and no longer jiggles in the center.
Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Lift out by the parchment, dust with powdered sugar and cut into 24 bars.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.description: Soft yeasted cinnamon rolls with a brown sugar filling and cream cheese frosting.
steps: Warm the milk to about 110°F. In a large bowl, stir together the milk, yeast and 1 tablespoon of the granulated sugar and let stand 5 to 10 minutes until foamy.
Melt 6 tablespoons of the butter. Add it to the yeast with the remaining granulated sugar, the eggs and salt. Stir in the flour a cup at a time until a soft dough forms.

Knead on a lightly floured surface for 6 to 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, adding a little flour only if very sticky. Place in a greased bowl, cover and let rise in a warm spot for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until doubled.
Soften the remaining butter. Mix 6 tablespoons of it with the brown sugar and cinnamon for the filling.
Roll the dough into a 16x12-inch rectangle. Spread the filling over it, leaving a 1/2-inch border on one long side. Roll up tightly from the other long side, pinch the seam, and cut into 12 rolls.
Arrange the rolls in a greased 9x13-inch pan, cover and let rise 30 to 45 minutes until puffy. Heat the oven to 350°F.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden brown and the centers reach about 190°F.
Beat the cream cheese with the remaining 4 tablespoons butter, the powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth. Spread over the warm rolls and serve.

recipes.title: Rice Krispie Treats
recipes.description: Chewy crisped rice cereal bars held together with melted marshmallows and butter.
steps: Butter a 9x13-inch pan.
Melt the butter in a large pot over low heat. Add the marshmallows and stir constantly until completely melted and smooth, 3 to 4 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla and salt.
Add the cereal and stir until evenly coated.
Turn into the pan and press gently into an even layer with buttered hands or a spatula; do not pack it hard.
Let cool for about 20 minutes until set, then cut into 24 squares.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding
recipes.description: Rich, silky stovetop chocolate pudding made with cocoa and semi-sweet chocolate.
steps: Chop the chocolate.
In a medium saucepan, whisk together the sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and salt. Slowly whisk in the milk until no lumps remain.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, for 6 to 8 minutes until the mixture thickens and starts to bubble. Cook and whisk 1 minute more.
Remove from the heat and whisk in the chocolate, butter and vanilla until melted and smooth.
Divide among 6 dessert cups or pour into a bowl. Press plastic wrap onto the surface to prevent a skin.
Chill for at least 2 hours until set before serving.

recipes.title: Homemade Ice Cream
recipes.description: Classic French vanilla ice cream made from a cooked egg custard and churned in an ice cream maker.
steps: Freeze the ice cream maker bowl for at least 24 hours if your machine requires it.
In a saucepan, heat the cream, milk, half of the sugar and the salt over medium heat until steaming and small bubbles form at the edge, about 5 minutes.

Separate the eggs, saving the whites for another use. Whisk the yolks with the remaining sugar until pale. Slowly whisk in about 1 cup of the hot cream to temper the yolks, then pour the mixture back into the saucepan.
Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly with a spatula, until the custard thickens enough to coat the spatula and reaches 170°F to 175°F, 4 to 6 minutes. Do not let it boil.
Strain into a bowl, stir in the vanilla, and cool. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight, until very cold.
Churn in the ice cream maker according to the manufacturer's directions, usually 20 to 25 minutes, until it looks like soft serve.
Transfer to a freezer container and freeze for at least 4 hours until firm enough to scoop.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs & Toast
recipes.description: Soft, creamy scrambled eggs cooked low and slow, served with buttered toast.
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the milk and salt and whisk until completely blended and slightly frothy.
Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs and let them sit for about 20 seconds, then slowly push them across the pan with a spatula to form soft curds. Keep stirring gently for 2 to 3 minutes.
While the eggs cook, toast the bread and spread it with the remaining butter.
Remove the eggs from the heat while they still look slightly wet; they will finish cooking on the plate. Season with pepper and sprinkle with green onions if you like.
Serve right away with the toast.

recipes.title: Sausage, Eggs & Hash Browns
recipes.description: A diner-style breakfast plate of homemade sausage patties, crispy shredded hash browns and fried eggs.
steps: Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes. Rinse them in cold water, then wrap in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Toss with 3/4 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper.

Shape the sausage into 8 patties about 1/2 inch thick. Cook in a large skillet over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until browned and the internal temperature reaches 160°F. Keep warm on a plate.

Heat the oil in a large nonstick or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Spread the potatoes in an even layer and press down. Cook without stirring for 5 to 6 minutes, until deep golden underneath.
Flip the hash browns in sections and cook another 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through.

Meanwhile, melt the butter in another skillet over medium heat. Crack in the eggs (in two batches if they will not fit in one layer) and cook to your liking, about 3 minutes for over-easy with a quick flip. Season with the remaining salt.
Divide the sausage, hash browns and eggs among plates and serve hot.

recipes.title: Breakfast Sandwiches
recipes.description: Toasted English muffins stacked with a sausage patty, a fried egg and melted American cheese.
steps: Shape the sausage into 4 thin patties slightly wider than the muffins. Cook in a skillet over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until browned and the internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Split and toast the English muffins.
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Crack in the eggs, break the yolks and season with salt and pepper. Cook 2 minutes, flip and cook 1 minute more.
Lay a cheese slice on each egg, cover the pan for 30 seconds to melt it.
Build each sandwich with a muffin bottom, sausage patty, cheesy egg and muffin top. Serve warm or wrap in foil to go.

recipes.title: Eggs Benedict
recipes.description: Toasted English muffins topped with seared Canadian bacon, poached eggs and quick blender hollandaise.
steps: For the hollandaise, separate 3 of the eggs (save the whites for another use). Blend the yolks, 1 tablespoon lemon juice from the half lemon, the salt and cayenne in a blender for 5 seconds.
Melt the butter until hot and bubbling. With the blender running, drizzle it in slowly until the sauce is thick and creamy. Pour into a bowl and keep warm near the stove.
Brown the Canadian bacon in a dry skillet over medium heat, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Split and toast the English muffins.
Bring a wide saucepan of water to a gentle simmer and add the vinegar. Crack each remaining egg into a small cup and slip it into the water, cooking 4 at a time.
Poach for 3 to 4 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny. Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain on a towel.
Top each muffin half with a slice of Canadian bacon and a poached egg. Spoon hollandaise over the top, garnish with parsley if using, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Breakfast Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crisp flour tortillas filled with scrambled eggs, bacon and melted cheddar.
steps: Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain on paper towels and crumble. Wipe out the skillet.
Whisk the eggs with the salt and pepper. Melt the butter in the skillet over medium-low heat and scramble the eggs until just set, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Shred the cheddar and slice the green onions.
Lay out the tortillas. On half of each, sprinkle some cheese, then the eggs, bacon and green onions, then a little more cheese. Fold the tortillas over.
Cook the quesadillas two at a time in the dry skillet over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese is melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream if desired.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Hearty toasted bread topped with lemony mashed avocado, flaky salt and a pinch of red pepper.
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Halve and pit the avocado and scoop it into a bowl. Add a squeeze of lemon juice and half the salt and mash with a fork, leaving it a little chunky.
Spread the avocado over the toast.
Sprinkle with the remaining salt, the pepper and red pepper flakes, and drizzle with olive oil if you like. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Homemade Muffins
recipes.description: Tender bakery-style blueberry muffins with a lightly sugared top.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners. Melt the butter and let it cool slightly.
In a large bowl, whisk the flour, sugar (reserve 1 tablespoon for the tops), baking powder and salt.
In another bowl, whisk the melted butter, eggs, milk and vanilla.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir with a spatula just until no dry flour remains; the batter should be lumpy. Gently fold in the blueberries.
Divide the batter among the cups, filling them nearly full, and sprinkle with the reserved sugar.
Bake for 20 to 24 minutes, until golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then move to a rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
recipes.description: A hot, creamy party dip of shredded chicken, cream cheese, ranch and buffalo hot sauce under melted cheddar.
steps: Put the chicken in a saucepan, cover with water by an inch and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer, cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Drain, cool slightly and shred with two forks.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Set the cream cheese out to soften and shred the cheddar.
In a bowl, stir together the cream cheese, ranch dressing and hot sauce until smooth. Fold in the chicken and half of the cheddar.
Spread in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish or 9-inch pie plate and top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 20 minutes, until hot and bubbling around the edges.
Sprinkle with sliced green onions if using and serve warm with tortilla chips and celery sticks.

recipes.title: Spinach & Artichoke Dip
recipes.description: A baked, bubbly dip of spinach, artichoke hearts and three cheeses.
steps: Thaw the spinach (one 10-ounce package) and squeeze it very dry in a towel. Drain the artichoke hearts and chop them. Mince the garlic and set the cream cheese out to soften.
Heat the oven to 350°F.
In a bowl, beat the cream cheese, sour cream and mayonnaise until smooth. Stir in the garlic, Parmesan, 1/2 cup of the mozzarella, the red pepper flakes and black pepper.
Fold in the spinach and artichokes and spread in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with the remaining mozzarella.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbly and lightly browned on top.
Let stand 5 minutes and serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Seven-Layer Dip
recipes.description: A make-ahead layered party dip of seasoned refried beans, sour cream, guacamole, salsa, cheddar, tomatoes, olives and green onions.
steps: Stir the taco seasoning into the refried beans and spread them evenly in the bottom of an 11x7-inch dish or a shallow 2 1/2-quart serving dish.
Spread the sour cream over the beans.
Mash the avocados with the juice of the lime, the salt and garlic powder and spread over the sour cream.
Spoon the salsa over the guacamole, letting excess liquid drain off first.
Shred the cheddar and sprinkle it over the salsa. Dice the tomato, slice the olives and green onions, and scatter them over the top.
Serve right away with tortilla chips, or cover tightly and refrigerate for up to 4 hours.

recipes.title: Guacamole & Chips
recipes.description: Chunky fresh guacamole with lime, onion, tomato, jalapeño and cilantro, served with tortilla chips.
steps: Finely dice the red onion and tomato. Seed and mince the jalapeño, mince the garlic and chop the cilantro.
Halve and pit the avocados and scoop them into a bowl. Add the juice of the lime and the salt and mash with a fork to the texture you like.
Fold in the onion, tomato, jalapeño, garlic and cilantro.
Taste and add more salt or lime if needed. Serve right away with tortilla chips, or press plastic wrap onto the surface and refrigerate for up to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Salsa & Tortilla Chips
recipes.description: Restaurant-style blender salsa made with canned tomatoes, fresh jalapeños, onion and cilantro, served with tortilla chips.
steps: Roughly chop the onion. Stem the jalapeños, removing the seeds for a milder salsa, and cut into chunks. Peel the garlic.
Put the onion, jalapeños, garlic and cilantro in a blender or food processor and pulse until finely chopped.
Add the tomatoes with their juices, the juice of the lime, the salt, cumin and sugar. Pulse 5 to 8 times until mostly smooth but still slightly chunky.
Taste and adjust the salt and lime. If you have time, refrigerate for 30 minutes to let the flavors blend.
Serve with tortilla chips. Leftover salsa keeps covered in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

recipes.title: Queso & Chips
recipes.description: A smooth, restaurant-style white queso dip with green chiles, jalapeño and tomato, served warm with tortilla chips.
steps: Finely dice the onion and tomato, seed and mince the jalapeño and mince the garlic. Shred the Monterey Jack and toss it with the cornstarch. Tear the American cheese into pieces.
Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Cook the onion and jalapeño for 3 to 4 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the evaporated milk and heat until steaming, but not boiling.
Reduce the heat to low and add the American cheese, then the Monterey Jack a handful at a time, stirring until each addition melts and the dip is smooth.
Stir in the green chiles, cumin and tomato and heat through. Thin with up to 1/4 cup water if it gets too thick.
Transfer to a warm bowl, sprinkle with cilantro if using and serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Mozzarella Sticks
recipes.description: Breaded string cheese fried until golden and gooey, served with warm marinara.
steps: Cut each string cheese stick in half crosswise to make 24 pieces.
Set up three shallow bowls: the flour in one, the eggs beaten with 1 tablespoon water in another, and the breadcrumbs mixed with the Parmesan, Italian seasoning and garlic powder in the third.
Dredge each piece in flour, dip in egg, then roll in crumbs. Dip again in egg and crumbs for a second coat, and set on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Freeze the breaded sticks for at least 1 hour so the cheese does not leak while frying.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot (about 2 inches deep) to 350°F. Fry the sticks in batches of 6 for 1 to 2 minutes, turning, until golden brown. Drain on a rack or paper towels.
Warm the marinara and serve it alongside the hot mozzarella sticks.

recipes.title: Jalapeño Poppers
recipes.description: Jalapeño halves stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked until crisp.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and set a wire rack on it. Set the cream cheese out to soften and shred the cheddar.
Wearing gloves, halve the jalapeños lengthwise and scrape out the seeds and ribs with a small spoon.
Mix the cream cheese, cheddar, garlic powder and green onions if using. Spoon into the jalapeño halves.
Cut each bacon slice in half crosswise and wrap one piece around each popper, tucking the ends underneath. Arrange on the rack.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the filling is bubbling.
Let cool 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Loaded Potato Skins
recipes.description: Crispy baked potato skins filled with cheddar and bacon and topped with sour cream and green onions.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Scrub the potatoes, pierce each a few times with a fork and bake directly on the oven rack for 50 to 60 minutes, until tender. Let cool 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon until crisp, drain and crumble. Shred the cheddar and slice the green onions.
Raise the oven to 450°F. Halve the potatoes lengthwise and scoop out the flesh, leaving a 1/4-inch shell (save the flesh for another use).
Brush the skins inside and out with the oil and season with the salt and pepper. Bake skin-side up on a sheet pan for 10 minutes, then flip and bake 10 minutes more until crisp.
Fill the skins with the cheddar and bacon and bake 3 to 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream and green onions and serve hot.

recipes.title: Pigs in a Blanket
recipes.description: Bite-size hot dog pieces wrapped in crescent roll dough and baked until golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Unroll the crescent dough and separate it into 8 triangles. Cut each triangle lengthwise into 3 narrow strips.
Cut each hot dog into 3 pieces. Roll each piece in a strip of dough, starting at the wide end, and place seam-side down on the baking sheet.
Beat the egg with 1 teaspoon water, brush it over the dough and sprinkle with sesame seeds if using.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until puffed and golden brown.
Serve warm with mustard and ketchup for dipping.

recipes.title: Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Oven-baked buffalo wings that get crisp skin from a baking powder rub, tossed in a classic butter and hot sauce coating.
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F with racks in the lower-middle and upper-middle positions. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and set a wire rack on it, sprayed with oil.
Pat the wings very dry with paper towels. If they are whole, cut them into drumettes and flats and discard the tips.
Toss the wings with the baking powder, salt and garlic powder until evenly coated. Arrange in a single layer on the rack, skin-side up.

Bake on the lower-middle rack for 30 minutes, then move to the upper-middle rack, raise the heat to 425°F and bake 40 to 50 minutes more, until golden and crisp and the internal temperature is at least 175°F.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small saucepan and whisk in the hot sauce.
Toss the hot wings in the sauce in a large bowl and serve right away with ranch dressing and celery sticks if desired.

recipes.title: Bruschetta
recipes.description: Toasted baguette slices rubbed with garlic and topped with fresh tomatoes, basil and a splash of balsamic.
steps: Seed and dice the tomatoes (Roma tomatoes work best). Mince 2 of the garlic cloves and thinly slice the basil.
In a bowl, combine the tomatoes, minced garlic, basil, 2 tablespoons of the olive oil, the balsamic vinegar, salt and pepper. Let stand 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F. Cut the baguette on a slight angle into 1/2-inch slices and arrange on a baking sheet. Brush the tops with the remaining olive oil.
Bake for 6 to 8 minutes, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Halve the remaining garlic clove and rub the cut side over the warm toasts.
Just before serving, spoon the tomato mixture over the toasts with a slotted spoon so they stay crisp.

recipes.title: Turkey & Cheese Sandwich
recipes.description: A classic deli-style sandwich with sliced turkey, Swiss cheese, lettuce and tomato on whole wheat bread.
steps: Lightly toast the bread if you like.
Spread mayonnaise on one slice and Dijon mustard on the other.
Layer the turkey and Swiss cheese on the mayonnaise slice, then add the romaine leaves and two thin tomato slices; season the tomato with a little pepper.
Close the sandwich with the mustard slice, press gently and cut in half diagonally.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter & Jelly Sandwich
recipes.description: Creamy peanut butter and strawberry jam on soft white bread.
steps: Lay the two slices of bread side by side.
Spread the peanut butter evenly over one slice, all the way to the edges.
Spread the jam over the second slice.
Press the slices together, filling sides in, and cut in half or into triangles.

recipes.title: Chef Salad
recipes.description: A hearty main-dish salad of crisp romaine topped with ham, turkey, two cheeses, hard-boiled eggs and fresh vegetables, served with ranch dressing.
steps: Place the eggs in a saucepan, cover with cold water by 1 inch and bring to a boil. Cover, remove from the heat and let stand 12 minutes, then transfer to ice water for 5 minutes. Peel and quarter.
While the eggs cook, chop the romaine, rinse and spin dry.
Cut the ham, turkey, cheddar and Swiss into thin strips. Cut the tomatoes into wedges, slice the cucumber and thinly slice the red onion.
Divide the romaine among four large plates or bowls.
Arrange the ham, turkey, cheeses, eggs, tomato, cucumber and onion in rows over the lettuce.
Season with black pepper and serve with ranch dressing on the side.

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crisp flour tortillas filled with seasoned chicken and melted Monterey Jack, served with salsa and sour cream.
steps: Cut the chicken into 1/2-inch pieces and toss with the taco seasoning.

Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken, stirring occasionally, for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through (165°F). Transfer to a bowl and wipe out the skillet.
Shred the cheese and slice the green onions.
Lay out 4 tortillas. Sprinkle each with a quarter of the cheese, then the chicken and green onions, and top with the remaining tortillas.
Melt 1/2 tablespoon butter in the skillet over medium heat. Cook one quesadilla for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese is melted. Repeat with the remaining butter and quesadillas.
Let rest 1 minute, cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Wraps
recipes.description: Seasoned seared chicken rolled in flour tortillas with romaine, tomato, cheddar, bacon and ranch.
steps: Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 8 minutes. Drain on paper towels, crumble, and pour off the fat.
Pound the chicken to an even 3/4-inch thickness and season with garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Chop the romaine, dice the tomato and shred the cheddar.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for a few seconds so they fold without cracking.
Spread 1 tablespoon ranch down the center of each tortilla, then top with romaine, chicken, tomato, cheddar and bacon.
Fold in the sides, roll up tightly and cut in half on the diagonal.

recipes.title: Turkey Wraps
recipes.description: Flour tortillas spread with herbed cream cheese and rolled up with turkey, Swiss, spinach and tomato.
steps: Stir the softened cream cheese with the Italian seasoning and pepper until smooth.
Thinly slice the tomato and red onion.
Spread 1 tablespoon of the cream cheese mixture over each tortilla, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Layer the turkey and Swiss over the lower two-thirds of each tortilla, then top with spinach, tomato and onion.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly from the bottom. Cut in half and serve, or wrap in plastic and refrigerate up to 1 day.

recipes.title: Baked Potato with Toppings
recipes.description: Crisp-skinned baked russet potatoes loaded with butter, sour cream, cheddar, bacon and green onions.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Scrub the potatoes, dry them well and prick each several times with a fork.
Rub the potatoes with olive oil, sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of the kosher salt and set directly on the oven rack with a sheet pan on the rack below.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes, until the skins are crisp and a knife slides easily into the center (about 205°F inside).
Meanwhile, cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, drain and crumble. Shred the cheddar and slice the green onions.
Slit each potato lengthwise, push the ends toward the center to open it and fluff the inside with a fork.
Top each potato with 1 tablespoon butter, the remaining salt and the pepper, then sour cream, cheddar, bacon and green onions. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
recipes.description: Thin chicken cutlets pan-seared and simmered in a mushroom and Marsala wine sauce.
steps: Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally and pound to an even 1/4-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper and dredge in flour, shaking off the excess.

Heat the olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in batches 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Transfer to a plate.
Slice the mushrooms, mince the shallot and garlic.
Add 1 tablespoon butter and the mushrooms to the skillet and cook 5 to 6 minutes, until browned. Add the shallot and garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the Marsala and scrape up the browned bits. Simmer 2 minutes, then add the broth and simmer 5 minutes, until reduced by about half.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon butter, return the chicken and any juices to the pan and simmer 2 minutes, spooning the sauce over the chicken.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
recipes.description: Pan-fried chicken cutlets in a bright lemon, butter and caper sauce.
steps: Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally and pound to 1/4-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper and dredge in flour, shaking off the excess.
Heat the olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in batches 3 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through to 165°F. Transfer to a plate.
Juice the lemons to get about 1/3 cup, drain the capers and mince the garlic.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add the broth, lemon juice and capers, scraping up the browned bits, and simmer 4 to 5 minutes until reduced by about a third.
Remove from the heat and swirl in the remaining 3 tablespoons butter until the sauce is glossy.
Return the chicken to the pan, turn to coat, and serve topped with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
recipes.description: Chicken breasts rolled around ham and Swiss cheese, coated in crisp panko and baked, served with a Dijon cream sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Place each chicken breast between plastic wrap and pound to 1/4-inch thickness. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Lay a quarter of the ham and Swiss on each breast, roll up tightly from the short end and secure with toothpicks.

Set up three shallow dishes: flour (reserve 2 tablespoons for the sauce), beaten eggs, and panko mixed with 3 tablespoons melted butter. Dredge each roll in flour, dip in egg, then press into the panko.
Place seam side down in the dish and bake 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.

Meanwhile, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a small saucepan over medium heat, whisk in the reserved 2 tablespoons flour and cook 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the milk and simmer 3 to 4 minutes until thickened, then stir in the Dijon and Parmesan.
Remove the toothpicks, slice the rolls and serve with the sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Kiev
recipes.description: Chicken breasts wrapped around cold garlic-herb butter, breaded and fried until crisp, then finished in the oven.
steps: Mash the softened butter with the minced garlic, chopped parsley, 1 teaspoon lemon juice and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Shape into four 3-inch logs on plastic wrap and freeze 30 minutes until firm.
Place each chicken breast between plastic wrap and pound to an even 1/4-inch thickness. Season with the remaining salt and the pepper.
Set a butter log at the short end of each breast, fold in the sides and roll up tightly so the butter is fully enclosed. Chill 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Dredge each roll in flour, dip in beaten egg, then coat in panko; repeat the egg and panko for a sealed crust.
Heat the oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Brown the rolls on all sides, about 6 minutes total.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake 18 to 22 minutes, until the internal temperature of the chicken reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before cutting so the garlic butter does not all run out at once.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Yogurt-marinated chicken broiled until charred, then simmered in a spiced creamy tomato sauce and served over basmati rice.
steps: Mince the garlic and grate the ginger. In a bowl, mix the yogurt, juice of the half lemon, 2 teaspoons garam masala, 1 teaspoon cumin, 1 teaspoon paprika, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, 1 teaspoon salt, and half the garlic and ginger. Cut the chicken into 1 1/2-inch pieces, toss in the marinade and refrigerate 1 to 8 hours.
Heat the broiler with a rack 6 inches from the heat. Spread the chicken on a foil-lined, oiled sheet pan and broil 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until charred in spots and cooked to 165°F.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and cook it with 3 cups water and 1/2 teaspoon salt: bring to a boil, cover, simmer on low 15 minutes, then rest 5 minutes.
Heat the oil and butter in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook 6 to 8 minutes until soft and golden.

Add the remaining garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute. Stir in the tomato paste, remaining 2 teaspoons garam masala, 1 teaspoon cumin, 1 teaspoon paprika, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric and the cayenne; cook 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes, sugar and remaining 1 teaspoon salt. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the cream and the broiled chicken with any juices and simmer 5 minutes more. Taste for salt.
Serve over the basmati rice, garnished with cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
recipes.description: A simple coconut milk chicken curry with onion, garlic, ginger and peas, served over jasmine rice.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook with 3 cups water: bring to a boil, cover, simmer on low 15 minutes, then rest 5 minutes.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and season with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Dice the onion, mince the garlic and grate the ginger.
Heat the oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken in two batches, about 4 minutes per batch, and transfer to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium, add the onion and cook 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, cumin and turmeric and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the coconut milk, broth and remaining 1 teaspoon salt. Return the chicken and bring to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered 15 minutes, until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in the peas and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the juice of the lime, taste for salt, and serve over the rice with cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken Gyros
recipes.description: Garlicky spiced chicken thighs, roasted and sliced, tucked into warm pitas with homemade tzatziki, tomato and onion.
steps: Mix 1/2 cup yogurt, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 4 cloves minced garlic, the oregano, cumin, paprika, coriander, 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Add the chicken, turn to coat and refrigerate 1 to 12 hours.

For the tzatziki, grate the cucumber, squeeze out as much liquid as possible and stir into the remaining 1 cup yogurt with the remaining clove of garlic (minced), 1 tablespoon olive oil, the juice of the half lemon and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Refrigerate until serving.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Arrange the chicken on a foil-lined sheet pan, letting excess marinade drip off.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes, until browned at the edges and the internal temperature reaches 175°F. For more char, broil 2 to 3 minutes at the end.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, then slice thinly. Slice the tomatoes and red onion.
Warm the pitas in the oven or a dry skillet for 1 minute per side.
Fill each pita with chicken, tzatziki, tomato and onion, and sprinkle with feta if using.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki
recipes.description: Lemon-oregano marinated chicken skewers grilled and served with pita, tzatziki and fresh vegetables.
steps: Cut the chicken into 1 1/4-inch cubes. Whisk 3 tablespoons olive oil, the juice of 1 lemon, 3 cloves minced garlic, the oregano, vinegar, 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Toss the chicken in the marinade and refrigerate 1 to 4 hours. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes.

For the tzatziki, grate the cucumber and squeeze it dry. Stir into the yogurt with the remaining garlic clove (minced), remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, the juice of the half lemon and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Chill.
Thread the chicken onto skewers and heat a grill to medium-high (about 425°F). Oil the grates.
Grill the skewers 10 to 12 minutes, turning every few minutes, until charred in spots and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Warm the pitas on the grill for 30 seconds per side. Slice the tomato and red onion.
Serve the skewers with the pitas, tzatziki, tomato and onion.

recipes.title: Chicken Caprese
recipes.description: Seared Italian-seasoned chicken breasts topped with fresh mozzarella, tomato and basil and drizzled with a balsamic reduction.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally to make 4 thin cutlets and season with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
