Simmer the balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan over medium-low heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until reduced to about 3 tablespoons and syrupy. Set aside; it will thicken as it cools.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken 3 minutes per side until golden.
Slice the mozzarella and tomatoes. Top each cutlet with tomato slices and mozzarella.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake 6 to 8 minutes, until the cheese melts and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Scatter torn basil over the chicken, drizzle with the balsamic reduction and serve.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken thighs glazed in a sticky honey, garlic and soy sauce.
steps: Pat the chicken dry and season with salt and pepper. Mince the garlic.
Whisk the honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar and 2 tablespoons water in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side, until browned and the internal temperature reaches 175°F. Transfer to a plate and pour off excess fat.
Lower the heat to medium, add the butter and garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the honey mixture and simmer 2 to 3 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Return the chicken to the pan and turn to coat for 1 to 2 minutes until glazed. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Chicken
recipes.description: Golden pan-seared chicken breasts in a light lemon, garlic and butter pan sauce.
steps: Pound the chicken to an even 3/4-inch thickness and season with salt, pepper and paprika. Mince the garlic; zest and juice the lemon.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side, until golden and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium and add 1 tablespoon butter and the garlic. Cook 30 to 60 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
Add the broth, lemon juice and zest, scraping up the browned bits, and simmer 3 minutes until reduced by about half.
Swirl in the remaining 2 tablespoons butter, return the chicken and juices to the pan and spoon the sauce over.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Orange Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy bite-size chicken tossed in a sweet and tangy fresh orange sauce, served over rice.
steps: Cook the rice with 3 cups water: bring to a boil, cover, simmer on low 18 minutes, then rest 5 minutes.

Zest one orange and juice the oranges to get 2/3 cup juice. Whisk the juice, zest, brown sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar, minced garlic, grated ginger and red pepper flakes in a bowl. In a small cup, stir 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces. Toss with the beaten egg and salt, then with the remaining cornstarch and the flour until evenly coated.
Heat the oil in a large deep skillet to 350°F. Fry the chicken in batches 4 to 5 minutes, turning, until golden, crisp and cooked through to 165°F. Drain on a rack or paper towels.
Pour off the oil and wipe out the skillet. Add the orange sauce, bring to a simmer over medium heat, then stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook 1 minute until thick and glossy.
Add the chicken and toss to coat. Serve right away over rice, topped with sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
recipes.description: Crisp pan-fried chicken with bell peppers, onion and pineapple in a homemade sweet and sour sauce.
steps: Cook the rice with 3 cups water: bring to a boil, cover, simmer on low 18 minutes, then rest 5 minutes.
Whisk the sugar, rice vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce, garlic powder and 1/4 cup water in a bowl. In a small cup, stir 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and season with salt. Toss in the remaining cornstarch, then dip in the beaten eggs, letting the excess drip off.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the chicken in batches 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through to 165°F. Drain on paper towels.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon oil. Cut the peppers and onion into 1-inch pieces and stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes until crisp-tender. Add the pineapple chunks and cook 1 minute.
Add the sauce and bring to a boil, then stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook 1 minute until thickened.
Return the chicken, toss to coat and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Cashew Chicken
recipes.description: A quick stir-fry of tender chicken, bell pepper and toasted cashews in a savory hoisin-soy sauce.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook with 2 1/4 cups water: bring to a boil, cover, simmer on low 15 minutes, then rest 5 minutes.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and toss with 1 tablespoon cornstarch and 1 tablespoon soy sauce.
Whisk the remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce, hoisin, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil, broth and remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
Toast the cashews in a dry large skillet or wok over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until golden; set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil over high heat and stir-fry the chicken in a single layer 5 to 6 minutes until browned and cooked through to 165°F. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the diced bell pepper and stir-fry 2 minutes. Add the minced garlic, grated ginger and the white parts of the green onions and cook 30 seconds.
Stir the sauce, pour it in and cook 1 minute until thickened. Return the chicken, add the cashews and green onion tops, toss and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: A spicy, slightly sweet chicken stir-fry with peanuts, bell pepper, zucchini and chile flakes.
steps: Cook the rice with 3 cups water: bring to a boil, cover, simmer on low 18 minutes, then rest 5 minutes.
Cut the chicken into 3/4-inch pieces and toss with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 2 teaspoons cornstarch.
Whisk the remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce, rice vinegar, hoisin, sugar, sesame oil, remaining 2 teaspoons cornstarch and 1/4 cup water.
Dice the bell pepper and zucchini into 3/4-inch pieces. Mince the garlic, grate the ginger and slice the green onions.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken 5 to 6 minutes until browned and cooked through to 175°F. Transfer to a plate.

Add the remaining oil and the red pepper flakes and stir 15 seconds. Add the bell pepper and zucchini and stir-fry 3 minutes until crisp-tender, then add the garlic, ginger and green onions for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, stir in the sauce and cook 1 minute until glossy. Toss in the peanuts and serve over rice.

recipes.title: General Tso's Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy fried chicken thigh pieces tossed in a sweet, savory and mildly spicy sauce, the takeout classic made at home.
steps: Cook the rice with 3 cups water: bring to a boil, cover, simmer on low 18 minutes, then rest 5 minutes.
Whisk the soy sauce, hoisin, rice vinegar, sugar, broth and 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch in a bowl.
Cut the chicken into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Toss with the beaten egg and salt, then with the remaining cornstarch until coated.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep skillet to 350°F. Fry the chicken in batches 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until crisp and cooked through to 175°F. Drain on a rack.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon oil. Over medium heat, cook the minced garlic, grated ginger and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Stir the sauce, add it to the pan and simmer 1 to 2 minutes until thick and glossy. Stir in the sesame oil.
Add the chicken and toss to coat. Serve over rice with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan Sliders
recipes.description: Crispy Parmesan-breaded chicken, marinara and melted mozzarella baked on soft slider rolls with garlic butter.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with parchment. Slice the chicken breasts horizontally into thin cutlets and season with salt.
Mix the panko, 1/2 cup Parmesan and 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning. Dip each cutlet in the beaten egg, then press into the crumbs.
Bake the cutlets 15 to 18 minutes, flipping once, until golden and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Reduce the oven to 350°F.
Without separating the rolls, slice the whole slab in half horizontally. Place the bottom half in a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle half the mozzarella over the bottom rolls, cover with the chicken cutlets (trimmed to fit), spread with marinara and top with the remaining mozzarella. Add the top half of the rolls.
Melt the butter with the garlic powder and remaining 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning; brush over the rolls and sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes, then uncover and bake 5 minutes more until the tops are golden and the cheese is melted.
Sprinkle with basil, cut between the rolls and serve warm.

recipes.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Casserole
recipes.description: Penne, chicken and bacon baked in a creamy ranch cheese sauce under a layer of melted cheddar.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cook the penne in salted boiling water 2 minutes less than the package directs; drain.
Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp, drain on paper towels and crumble. Leave 1 tablespoon fat in the pan.
Cut the chicken into 3/4-inch pieces, season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and the pepper, and cook in the bacon fat over medium-high heat 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through (165°F).

In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat, whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk and broth and simmer 4 to 5 minutes until thickened. Remove from the heat and stir in the ranch, remaining salt and half the shredded cheddar.
Stir the pasta, chicken and most of the bacon into the sauce and spread in the dish. Top with the remaining cheddar and bacon.
Bake uncovered 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbly and the cheese is melted. Rest 5 minutes and garnish with green onions.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
recipes.description: Chicken, broccoli and rice baked together in a creamy cheddar sauce with a buttery crumb topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bring 2 cups broth to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes until tender.
Cut the chicken into 3/4-inch pieces, season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and the pepper, and cook in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through (165°F).
Steam or microwave the broccoli florets 3 minutes until bright green but still firm; chop any large pieces.

Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a saucepan over medium heat, add the diced onion and cook 4 minutes. Whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk and remaining 1/2 cup broth. Simmer until thickened, about 4 minutes. Stir in the garlic powder, remaining salt and three-quarters of the shredded cheddar.
Combine the rice, chicken, broccoli and sauce and spread in the dish. Sprinkle with the remaining cheddar.
Melt the remaining 1 tablespoon butter, toss with the panko and scatter over the top.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly and golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
recipes.description: Tender chicken and broccoli baked in a lemony cheddar cream sauce with a crisp crumb topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Place the chicken in a saucepan, cover with water by 1 inch, add 1/2 teaspoon salt and bring to a simmer. Cook gently 12 to 15 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Cool slightly and slice.
Steam the broccoli florets 3 to 4 minutes until crisp-tender and arrange them in the baking dish. Lay the chicken slices over the broccoli.
Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the broth and simmer 3 to 4 minutes until thickened.
Remove from the heat and whisk in the mayonnaise, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, curry powder, pepper, remaining salt and half the shredded cheddar. Pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheddar. Melt the remaining 1 tablespoon butter, toss with the panko and scatter over the top.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly and golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie Soup
recipes.description: All the flavors of chicken pot pie, with chicken, potatoes, carrots, celery and peas in a creamy thyme broth.
steps: Dice the onion, carrots and celery, mince the garlic, and peel and cut the potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes.
Melt the butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook 6 to 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir 1 to 2 minutes. Slowly stir in the broth, scraping the bottom, until smooth.

Add the potatoes, whole chicken breasts, thyme, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer, cover partially and cook 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the potatoes are tender.
Remove the chicken, shred with two forks and return it to the pot.
Stir in the peas and cream and simmer 5 minutes until heated through. Taste for salt and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Gnocchi Soup
recipes.description: A creamy chicken soup with soft potato gnocchi, vegetables and spinach, in the style of the popular restaurant version.
steps: Finely dice the onion, carrots and celery and mince the garlic.
Heat the butter and olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery 6 to 8 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the flour and cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the broth.
Add the whole chicken breasts, thyme, salt and pepper. Simmer, partially covered, 15 to 18 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F. Remove, shred and return to the pot.
Stir in the half and half and gnocchi and simmer gently 3 to 4 minutes, until the gnocchi float and are tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, taste for salt, and serve topped with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
recipes.description: A brothy, chili-spiced chicken soup with black beans, corn and tomatoes, topped with baked tortilla strips and melted cheese.
steps: Dice the onion, seed and mince the jalapeño and mince the garlic.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook the onion and jalapeño 5 minutes, then add the garlic, chili powder, cumin and oregano and cook 1 minute.
Add the broth, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes with their juice, whole chicken breasts and 1 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer covered 18 to 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Meanwhile, heat the oven to 400°F. Cut the tortillas into thin strips, toss with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and 1/4 teaspoon salt, and bake on a sheet pan 8 to 10 minutes until crisp.
Remove the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot with the drained, rinsed black beans and corn. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the lime juice and taste for salt.
Ladle into bowls and top with shredded Monterey Jack, tortilla strips, and sour cream, cilantro and diced avocado as desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: A light, brothy soup loaded with chicken and vegetables, seasoned with thyme and bay leaf.
steps: Dice the onion, slice the carrots and celery, mince the garlic, and cut the potato into 1/2-inch cubes.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery 6 to 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.

Add the broth, tomatoes with their juice, whole chicken breasts, potato, thyme, bay leaf, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook covered 18 to 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove the chicken and shred it. Trim the green beans into 1-inch pieces and dice the zucchini.
Add the green beans to the pot and simmer 5 minutes, then add the zucchini, corn and shredded chicken and simmer 5 minutes more until all the vegetables are tender.
Discard the bay leaf, taste for salt and pepper, and serve sprinkled with parsley.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Tortellini Soup
recipes.description: Cheese tortellini, shredded chicken and spinach in a creamy Parmesan and Italian herb broth.
steps: Dice the onion, carrots and celery and mince the garlic.
Melt the butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery 6 to 8 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the broth.
Add the whole chicken breasts, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Simmer, partially covered, 15 to 18 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F. Remove, shred and return to the pot.
Bring the soup back to a gentle boil, add the tortellini and cook according to the package, usually 7 to 9 minutes, until tender.
Lower the heat and stir in the cream, Parmesan and spinach until the spinach wilts. Do not boil. Taste for salt and serve.

recipes.title: French Dip Sandwiches
recipes.description: Thinly sliced roast beef and melted provolone on toasted hoagie rolls, served with a savory au jus for dipping.
steps: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook 5 minutes until soft, then add the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broth, Worcestershire, soy sauce, thyme and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes to make the au jus.
Heat the broiler. Split the rolls, spread the cut sides with the remaining 2 tablespoons butter and broil 1 to 2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the roast beef to the simmering jus for 1 minute just to warm it, then lift it out with tongs and pile it onto the bottom halves of the rolls.
Top each with a slice of provolone and broil 1 minute until melted. Close the sandwiches.
Strain the jus if you like and serve it in small bowls for dipping.

recipes.title: Italian Beef Sandwiches
recipes.description: Chicago-style slow-cooked seasoned beef, shredded and piled on hoagie rolls with sweet peppers, giardiniera and provolone.
steps: Pat the roast dry and season all over with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the roast 3 to 4 minutes per side until well browned. Transfer to a slow cooker.
Add the smashed garlic, broth, Italian seasoning, oregano and red pepper flakes to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low 8 to 9 hours (or high 5 to 6 hours), until the beef is fall-apart tender.
Remove the beef, shred it with two forks and return it to the juices. Skim the fat if needed.
Slice the bell peppers into strips, add them to the slow cooker and cook on high 30 minutes until tender.
Split the rolls, fill with beef using tongs, and top with peppers, giardiniera and provolone. Spoon extra juice over the beef or serve it on the side for dipping.

recipes.title: Roast Beef Sandwiches
recipes.description: Deli-style roast beef sandwiches on whole wheat with provolone, Dijon mayo, lettuce, tomato and red onion.
steps: Stir the mayonnaise, Dijon and pepper together.
Thinly slice the tomato and red onion.
Toast the bread if you like and spread the Dijon mayo on one side of each slice.
Layer the roast beef, provolone, romaine, tomato and onion on four slices.
Top with the remaining bread, press gently and cut in half.

recipes.title: Reuben Sandwiches
recipes.description: Grilled rye bread sandwiches filled with corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut and homemade Russian dressing.
steps: For the dressing, stir together the mayonnaise, ketchup, finely chopped pickle and Worcestershire.
Drain the sauerkraut well and squeeze out the excess liquid.
Spread one side of each bread slice with softened butter. Turn 4 slices butter side down and spread with the dressing.
Layer each with Swiss, corned beef and sauerkraut, then top with the remaining bread, butter side up.

Cook in a large skillet or griddle over medium-low heat 4 to 5 minutes per side, pressing gently, until the bread is golden and the cheese is melted. Cover the pan for the first side to help the filling heat through.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Patty Melts
recipes.description: Thin beef patties with caramelized onions and melted Swiss cheese, griddled between slices of buttery rye bread.
steps: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Add the thinly sliced onions and a pinch of salt and cook, stirring occasionally, 20 to 25 minutes until deep golden. Transfer to a bowl.
Mix the ground beef with the Worcestershire, remaining salt and the pepper. Shape into 4 thin oval patties about the shape of the bread.
Raise the heat to medium-high and cook the patties 3 minutes per side, until the internal temperature reaches 160°F. Transfer to a plate and wipe out the skillet.

Spread the remaining butter on one side of each bread slice. On 4 slices, butter side down, layer a slice of Swiss, a patty, the onions and another slice of Swiss, then top with the remaining bread, butter side up.
Cook over medium-low heat 3 to 4 minutes per side, pressing gently, until the bread is crisp and the cheese is melted. Cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Sandwiches
recipes.description: Buttermilk-marinated fried chicken breasts on toasted buns with mayo and pickles.
steps: Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally to make 4 cutlets about 1/2 inch thick. Stir 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper and 1/2 teaspoon each paprika and garlic powder into the buttermilk, add the chicken and refrigerate 30 minutes to 8 hours.
Whisk the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, cayenne and the remaining salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder in a shallow dish.
Heat the oil in a large heavy skillet or Dutch oven (about 1 inch deep) to 350°F.
Lift each cutlet from the buttermilk, let the excess drip off and press firmly into the flour mixture to coat.
Fry two pieces at a time 3 to 4 minutes per side, until deep golden and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Drain on a wire rack.
Butter the cut sides of the buns and toast in a skillet until golden.
Spread mayonnaise on the buns and build the sandwiches with the chicken and pickle slices.

recipes.title: Pulled Chicken Sandwiches
recipes.description: Spice-rubbed chicken thighs slow-cooked in barbecue sauce, shredded and piled on buns.
steps: Mix the brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, salt and pepper, and rub it all over the chicken.
Slice the onion and spread it in the bottom of a slow cooker. Lay the chicken on top.
Whisk 1 cup of the BBQ sauce with the vinegar and 1/4 cup water and pour over the chicken.
Cover and cook on low 6 hours or high 3 to 4 hours, until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken in the cooker with two forks and stir in the remaining 1/2 cup BBQ sauce. Cook on warm 15 minutes so the meat absorbs the sauce.
Toast the buns if you like and pile on the chicken. Top with pickles.

recipes.title: Italian Sub Sandwiches
recipes.description: Hoagie rolls stacked with ham, salami, pepperoni and provolone, topped with lettuce, tomato, onion and an oil and vinegar dressing.
steps: Whisk the olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Shred the lettuce and thinly slice the tomatoes and red onion.
Split the rolls without cutting all the way through and brush the insides with a little of the dressing.
Layer each roll with 2 slices provolone, then the ham, salami and pepperoni.
Top with lettuce, tomato and onion, drizzle with the remaining dressing, close and cut in half.

recipes.title: Meatball Subs
recipes.description: Oven-baked beef meatballs simmered in marinara and piled into toasted hoagie rolls under melted provolone.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with foil or parchment.

In a large bowl, stir the breadcrumbs and milk together and let sit 5 minutes. Add the ground beef, egg, Parmesan, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper and mix gently with your hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into 18 meatballs about 1 1/2 inches across and arrange them on the baking sheet.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until browned and the internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Meanwhile, warm the marinara in a large saucepan over medium-low heat. Add the baked meatballs and simmer for 10 minutes, turning to coat.
Split the hoagie rolls without cutting all the way through, set them on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 3 to 4 minutes.
Fill each roll with 3 meatballs and a spoonful of sauce, then top with a slice of provolone.
Return the subs to the oven for 3 to 5 minutes, until the cheese is melted. Sprinkle with torn basil and serve with extra sauce.

recipes.title: Ham Salad Sandwiches
recipes.description: Old-fashioned ham salad made with finely chopped ham, mayonnaise, sweet relish and celery, served on soft bread.
steps: Cut the ham into 1-inch pieces and pulse in a food processor 8 to 10 times, until finely chopped but not pasty. (You can also chop it finely by hand.)
Finely dice the celery.
In a medium bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, relish, mustard and pepper. Fold in the ham and celery until evenly coated.
Chill for 30 minutes if you have time; the flavors blend as it sits.
Spread about 1/2 cup ham salad on 4 slices of bread, add lettuce leaves if using, and top with the remaining bread. Cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Sandwiches
recipes.description: Creamy egg salad with mayonnaise, a little Dijon, celery and green onion on soft sandwich bread.
steps: Place the eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Bring to a boil over high heat, then cover, remove from the heat and let stand 12 minutes.
Transfer the eggs to a bowl of ice water for 5 minutes, then peel them.
Chop the eggs and place them in a bowl. Finely dice the celery and thinly slice the green onions.
Add the mayonnaise, Dijon, celery, green onions, salt and pepper and stir gently until combined. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Divide the egg salad among 4 slices of bread, dust with paprika and add lettuce if using. Top with the remaining bread, cut and serve.

recipes.title: BLT Pasta Salad
recipes.description: A cold pasta salad with crisp bacon, tomatoes and romaine tossed in a creamy, tangy mayonnaise dressing.
steps: Cook the penne in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions until just tender. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until crisp. Drain on paper towels and crumble.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, sour cream, vinegar, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Seed and dice the tomatoes. Add the pasta and tomatoes to the dressing and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Just before serving, chop the romaine and fold it in along with most of the bacon. Top with the remaining bacon and sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Caprese Sandwiches
recipes.description: Toasted rolls layered with fresh mozzarella, ripe tomato and basil, finished with olive oil and a quick balsamic glaze.
steps: Simmer the balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan over medium-low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until reduced by about half and syrupy. Let cool; it thickens as it cools.
Heat the broiler. Split the rolls, brush the cut sides with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil and broil for 1 to 2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Cut the garlic clove in half and rub the cut side over the toasted bread.
Slice the mozzarella and tomatoes about 1/4 inch thick. Season the tomatoes with salt and pepper.
Layer the mozzarella, tomatoes and basil leaves on the bottom halves of the rolls.
Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and the balsamic glaze, close the sandwiches and serve.

recipes.title: Turkey Melts
recipes.description: Griddled turkey and Swiss sandwiches with tomato and a Dijon mayonnaise spread.
steps: Stir the mayonnaise and Dijon together in a small bowl. Thinly slice the tomato and soften the butter.
Spread the mustard mayonnaise on one side of each bread slice.
On 4 slices, layer half the Swiss cheese, the turkey, the tomato slices and the remaining Swiss. Top with the other slices, spread side down.
Spread the outsides of the sandwiches with the softened butter.
Cook in a large skillet or griddle over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, covering the pan for the first side, until golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Tuna Melts
recipes.description: Classic diner-style tuna salad sandwiches griddled with melted cheddar.
steps: Drain the tuna well and flake it into a bowl.
Finely dice the celery and red onion (about 2 tablespoons onion). Add them to the tuna with the mayonnaise, the juice of the lemon half, Dijon and pepper, and stir to combine.
Slice the cheddar. Divide the tuna salad among 4 slices of bread, top each with cheddar and close with the remaining bread.
Soften the butter and spread it on the outsides of the sandwiches.
Cook in a large skillet over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, covering the pan for the first side, until golden and the cheese is melted. Cut and serve.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
recipes.description: Tender strips of sirloin and browned mushrooms in a sour cream gravy, served over egg noodles.
steps: Slice the steak against the grain into strips about 1/4 inch thick and 2 inches long. Season with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Sear the beef in batches in a single layer for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until browned. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter. Add the diced onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until softened.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 6 to 7 minutes, until their liquid evaporates and they brown. Stir in the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the broth, Worcestershire and Dijon, and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, until thickened.
Meanwhile, cook the egg noodles in salted boiling water according to package directions and drain.

Reduce the heat to low. Stir a few spoonfuls of the hot sauce into the sour cream, then stir the sour cream into the skillet. Return the beef and its juices and heat through for 2 minutes without boiling.
Serve over the noodles, sprinkled with parsley.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef patties simmered in a mushroom and onion gravy.
steps: In a bowl, combine the ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, ketchup, 1 tablespoon of the Worcestershire, onion powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Mix gently and shape into 4 oval patties about 1/2 inch thick.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side, then transfer to a plate. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat.
Reduce the heat to medium, add the butter, sliced onion and sliced mushrooms, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned and tender.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the broth and the remaining 1 teaspoon Worcestershire and bring to a simmer.
Return the patties to the skillet, spooning the gravy over them. Cover and simmer over low heat for 12 to 15 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 160°F.
Serve the patties smothered in gravy, garnished with parsley, with mashed potatoes if you like.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs
recipes.description: Tender beef and pork meatballs with a hint of nutmeg in a creamy brown gravy, served over egg noodles.
steps: In a large bowl, combine the breadcrumbs and milk and let soak for 5 minutes.
Grate the onion half and add it to the bowl with the beef, pork, egg, nutmeg, salt and pepper. Mix gently and roll into 1 1/4-inch meatballs (about 30).
Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Brown the meatballs in batches for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until browned on all sides and cooked to 160°F. Transfer to a plate.
Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter in the skillet and whisk in the flour. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until light golden.
Slowly whisk in the broth, then the cream, Worcestershire and Dijon. Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick enough to coat a spoon.
Return the meatballs to the gravy and simmer for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the egg noodles in salted boiling water according to package directions and drain.
Serve the meatballs and gravy over the noodles, sprinkled with parsley.

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi
recipes.description: Thinly sliced beef marinated in a sweet soy, garlic and pear marinade, seared hot and served over rice.
steps: Freeze the steak for 30 minutes to firm it, then slice it against the grain as thinly as possible, about 1/8 inch.
Peel and grate the pear half. In a bowl, whisk the pear, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, pepper and half of the sliced green onions.
Add the beef, toss to coat and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and up to 4 hours.
Rinse the rice and cook it with 2 1/4 cups water according to package directions.

Heat the vegetable oil in a large cast-iron skillet over high heat. Lift the beef from the marinade and cook in batches in a single layer for 2 to 3 minutes, until caramelized at the edges and cooked through.
Serve over the rice, topped with the remaining green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: Takeout-style stir-fry of tender flank steak and crisp-tender broccoli in a glossy soy-garlic sauce.
steps: Cook the rice with 3 cups water according to package directions.
Slice the flank steak against the grain into thin strips and toss with 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch.
In a small bowl, whisk the remaining soy sauce, the broth, brown sugar, hoisin, sesame oil and remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
Put the broccoli florets in a large skillet or wok with 1/4 cup water, cover and steam over medium-high heat for 3 minutes, until bright green and crisp-tender. Drain and set aside.
Wipe the pan dry and heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over high heat. Sear the beef in two batches for 2 to 3 minutes, adding the remaining oil as needed, until browned. Transfer to a plate.
Add the minced garlic and ginger to the pan and stir for 30 seconds. Whisk the sauce again, pour it in and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, until thickened and glossy.
Return the beef and broccoli to the pan and toss to coat. Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Mongolian Beef
recipes.description: Crisp cornstarch-coated flank steak tossed in a sweet, garlicky soy and ginger glaze with green onions.
steps: Cook the rice with 3 cups water according to package directions.
Slice the flank steak against the grain into thin strips, pat dry and toss with the cornstarch until coated. Shake off the excess.

Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the beef in batches in a single layer for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until crisp and browned. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
Pour off any remaining oil, add the last tablespoon of oil and reduce the heat to medium. Cook the minced garlic and grated ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce, brown sugar, 1/3 cup water and the red pepper flakes. Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Return the beef to the pan with the green onions cut into 1-inch pieces and toss for 1 minute, until glazed. Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Korean Beef Bowls
recipes.description: Quick ground beef cooked in a sweet soy, garlic and sesame sauce, served over rice with fresh cucumber.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it with 2 1/4 cups water according to package directions.
In a small bowl, stir together the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil and red pepper flakes.
Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, until it reduces and coats the beef. Stir in most of the green onions.
Divide the rice among bowls, top with the beef and sliced cucumber, and finish with the remaining green onions, sesame seeds and a drizzle of sriracha.

recipes.title: Cheesesteak Sliders
recipes.description: Thin-sliced steak with sautéed onions and peppers baked with provolone on sweet rolls under a garlic butter top.
steps: Freeze the steak for 30 minutes, then slice it as thinly as possible. Heat the oven to 350°F.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the thinly sliced onion and pepper for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and lightly browned. Transfer to a bowl.

Increase the heat to high, add the remaining oil and the steak. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, chopping it with a spatula, until no longer pink. Season with the Worcestershire, salt and pepper and stir the vegetables back in.
Without separating the rolls, slice the whole slab in half horizontally. Place the bottom half in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Layer 4 slices of provolone, the steak mixture and the remaining 4 slices of provolone over the bottom half, then replace the top.
Melt the butter with the garlic powder and brush it over the tops of the rolls.
Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes, then uncover and bake 5 minutes more, until the cheese is melted and the tops are golden. Cut into individual sliders and serve.

recipes.title: Beef Kabobs
recipes.description: Marinated sirloin cubes grilled on skewers with peppers, red onion and mushrooms.
steps: Cut the steak into 1 1/4-inch cubes.
In a bowl or zip-top bag, combine the olive oil, soy sauce, Worcestershire, juice of the lemon, minced garlic, brown sugar and pepper. Add the beef, toss to coat and refrigerate for 2 to 8 hours.
If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes.

Cut the peppers and onion into 1 1/2-inch pieces and trim the mushroom stems. Thread the beef and vegetables alternately onto the skewers and sprinkle the vegetables with the salt. Discard the marinade.
Heat the grill to medium-high (400 to 450°F) and oil the grates.
Grill the kabobs for 8 to 10 minutes, turning every 2 to 3 minutes, until the beef reaches 135°F for medium-rare or 145°F for medium.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Steak Fajitas
recipes.description: Lime and chili-marinated flank steak seared hot with peppers and onions, served in warm flour tortillas.
steps: Whisk 2 tablespoons of the oil, the juice of both limes, minced garlic, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Coat the steak and marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 4 hours.
Slice the peppers and onion into thin strips.

Heat a large cast-iron skillet over high heat until very hot. Remove the steak from the marinade and sear for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until it reaches 135°F for medium-rare. Rest on a cutting board for 10 minutes.
Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the skillet and cook the peppers and onion for 6 to 8 minutes, until charred in spots and crisp-tender.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in foil in a 350°F oven for 10 minutes.
Slice the steak thinly against the grain and toss with the vegetables.
Serve in the tortillas with sour cream, salsa, sliced avocado and cilantro.

recipes.title: Steak Sandwiches
recipes.description: Seared sirloin sliced thin on toasted hoagie rolls with caramelized onions, mushrooms, melted provolone and garlic mayo.
steps: Season the steak with the salt and pepper and let it sit at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the steak for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until it reaches 135°F for medium-rare. Transfer to a cutting board and rest for 10 minutes.
Reduce the heat to medium, add the butter and the thinly sliced onion and cook for 10 minutes, stirring often. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook 5 to 6 minutes more, until both are golden.
Stir the mayonnaise with the finely grated garlic.
Heat the broiler. Split the rolls, place them cut side up on a baking sheet and broil for 1 to 2 minutes, until toasted.
Slice the steak thinly against the grain. Pile it on the bottom halves of the rolls, top with the onions and mushrooms and 2 slices of provolone each, and broil for 1 minute, until melted.
Spread the garlic mayo on the top halves, close the sandwiches and serve.

recipes.title: Corned Beef and Cabbage
recipes.description: Corned beef brisket simmered low and slow, with potatoes, carrots and cabbage wedges cooked in the flavorful broth.
steps: Rinse the brisket and place it fat side up in a large Dutch oven or stockpot with the enclosed spice packet, the quartered onion, smashed garlic and bay leaves.
Cover with cold water by 1 inch and bring to a boil over high heat. Skim any foam, reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 2 1/2 to 3 hours (about 50 minutes per pound), until fork-tender.
Transfer the brisket to a cutting board and tent with foil.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into 2-inch chunks; peel the carrots and cut them into 2-inch pieces. Add them to the simmering liquid and cook for 10 minutes.
Cut a medium head of cabbage (about 10 cups) into 8 wedges through the core, add them to the pot and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, until all the vegetables are tender.
Slice the corned beef thinly against the grain.
Lift the vegetables out with a slotted spoon, toss with the butter and parsley, and serve alongside the beef with mustard.

recipes.title: Cabbage Rolls
recipes.description: Tender cabbage leaves wrapped around a beef, pork and rice filling and baked in a sweet-tangy tomato sauce.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cut out the core of a large head of cabbage and lower it into the water. As the outer leaves soften, after 2 to 3 minutes each, peel them off with tongs until you have 12 large leaves. Drain and shave down the thick rib on each leaf.
Cook the rice in a small pot of boiling water for 10 minutes, then drain; it will finish cooking in the oven.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the diced onion for 5 minutes, until soft. Add the minced garlic for 30 seconds and let cool slightly.
Heat the oven to 350°F. In a bowl, mix the beef, pork, rice, onion mixture, egg, paprika, salt and pepper.
Stir together the tomato sauce, brown sugar and vinegar. Spread 1 cup in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Place about 1/3 cup filling near the base of each leaf, fold in the sides and roll up. Set the rolls seam side down in the dish.
Pour the remaining 2 cups sauce over the rolls, cover tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, until the filling reaches 160°F.
Let rest for 10 minutes, then serve with the sauce spooned over.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage Soup
recipes.description: All the flavor of cabbage rolls in a hearty soup of ground beef, cabbage, rice and tomatoes.
steps: Brown the ground beef in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up. Drain off excess fat.
Add the diced onion and carrots and cook for 5 minutes, until softened. Stir in the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until it starts to wilt.
Stir in the diced tomatoes with their juice, tomato sauce, broth, paprika, thyme, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Stir in the rice, reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the rice and cabbage are tender.
Stir in the brown sugar and vinegar, taste and add more salt only if needed (the broth is already salty), and serve sprinkled with parsley.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin
recipes.description: Pork tenderloin rubbed with Dijon, garlic and fresh herbs, seared and roasted until juicy.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Pat the two tenderloins dry and trim off the silver skin.
Stir together 1 tablespoon of the oil, the Dijon, minced garlic, chopped rosemary and thyme, brown sugar, salt and pepper. Rub it all over the pork.
Heat the remaining oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the pork for about 2 minutes per side, until browned all over, about 8 minutes total.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast for 12 to 15 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Rest the pork on a cutting board for 10 minutes.
Slice 1/2 inch thick and spoon the pan juices over the top.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Tacos
recipes.description: Slow-cooker spiced pulled pork in corn tortillas with a quick lime-cilantro cabbage slaw.
steps: Mix the brown sugar, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano, 2 teaspoons of the salt and the pepper. Trim excess fat from the pork, cut it into 3 or 4 large pieces and rub the spice mix all over.
Slice the yellow onion into the bottom of a slow cooker, set the pork on top and pour in the broth and vinegar.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, until the pork shreds easily (about 195 to 205°F).
Shred the pork with two forks, discarding any large pieces of fat. Toss with about 1/2 cup of the cooking juices and the juice of 1 lime.
For the slaw, toss the thinly sliced cabbage with half the chopped cilantro, the juice of 1 lime and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet over medium-high heat for 30 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with pork and slaw, top with diced red onion and the remaining cilantro, and serve with lime wedges, sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Pork Carnitas
recipes.description: Pork shoulder braised with orange, lime and garlic until tender, then shredded and crisped in a hot skillet.
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F. Cut the pork into 2-inch chunks, trimming any thick pieces of fat, and toss with the salt, pepper, cumin and oregano.

Place the pork in a Dutch oven. Squeeze in the juice of the orange and 1 lime, then add the squeezed orange halves, 1 onion cut into quarters, smashed garlic, bay leaves and the halved jalapeño. Add about 2 cups water, enough to come about halfway up the pork.
Bring to a simmer on the stove, cover and braise in the oven for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, until the pork falls apart when pressed.
Transfer the pork to a sheet pan and shred it with two forks. Strain the cooking liquid and skim off the fat.

Heat the lard in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Add the pork in a single layer (in batches), drizzle with about 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid and cook without stirring for 4 to 5 minutes, until crisp underneath. Flip and crisp briefly on the other side.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet. Finely dice the remaining half onion and chop the cilantro.
Serve the carnitas in the tortillas topped with onion, cilantro, salsa and wedges of the remaining limes.

recipes.title: Pork Schnitzel
recipes.description: Thin pork cutlets breaded and pan-fried until golden and crisp, served with lemon wedges.
steps: Place each chop between sheets of plastic wrap and pound to an even 1/4-inch thickness. Season both sides with the salt and pepper.
Set up three shallow dishes: the flour in one, the eggs beaten with 1 tablespoon water in the second, and the breadcrumbs in the third.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, dip in egg letting the excess drip off, then press into the breadcrumbs to coat. Do not let the coated cutlets sit long before frying.
Heat the oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches about 350°F.
Fry the cutlets 1 or 2 at a time for 2 to 3 minutes per side, gently swirling the pan, until deep golden and the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Drain on a wire rack set over paper towels. Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkle of parsley.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Pork Chops
recipes.description: Pan-seared boneless pork chops finished in a sticky honey, garlic and soy glaze.
steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season both sides with the salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chops for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until golden and the internal temperature reaches 145°F. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and melt the butter in the skillet. Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Stir in the honey, soy sauce and vinegar and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Return the chops and any juices to the pan and spoon the glaze over them for 1 minute.
Serve with the extra glaze spooned on top and sprinkled with sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Ham and Bean Casserole
recipes.description: Diced ham and white beans baked in a savory tomato-herb sauce under cheddar and buttery panko.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch (3-quart) baking dish.
Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the diced onion and celery for 5 minutes, until softened, then add the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the ham, cut into 1/2-inch dice, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until lightly browned.
Stir in the drained, rinsed beans, the tomatoes with their juice, broth, thyme and pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour into the baking dish and top with the shredded cheddar. Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter, toss with the panko and sprinkle over the top.
Bake for 25 minutes, until bubbling and the topping is golden. Let stand 5 minutes and sprinkle with parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Ham and Potato Casserole
recipes.description: Thinly sliced potatoes and diced ham baked in a creamy cheddar sauce until tender and golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. Peel the potatoes and slice them 1/8 inch thick; dice the ham.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the diced onion for 4 minutes. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.

Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer, stirring, for 4 to 5 minutes, until thickened. Remove from the heat and stir in 6 ounces of the shredded cheddar, the salt, pepper and garlic powder until smooth.
Layer half the potatoes in the dish, top with half the ham and half the sauce. Repeat with the remaining potatoes, ham and sauce.
Cover with foil and bake for 60 minutes.
Uncover, sprinkle with the remaining cheddar and bake 20 to 30 minutes more, until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife and the top is golden.
Let rest 10 minutes and sprinkle with green onions before serving.

recipes.title: Sausage and Potato Skillet
recipes.description: Smoked sausage and crispy diced potatoes cooked in one skillet with onion, bell pepper and paprika.
steps: Cut the potatoes into 3/4-inch cubes. Place in a microwave-safe bowl with 2 tablespoons water, cover and microwave for 5 minutes, until just starting to soften. Drain.
Slice the sausage into 1/2-inch coins. Brown in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes, then transfer to a plate.
Add the oil and the potatoes to the skillet in an even layer. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring only every few minutes, until golden and crisp.
Add the diced onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes, until tender. Stir in the minced garlic, paprika, salt and pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Return the sausage to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes to heat through. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
recipes.description: A make-ahead egg, bread, sausage and cheddar bake that's assembled the night before and baked in the morning.
steps: Cook the sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, breaking it into crumbles, until no longer pink. Drain on paper towels.
Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish. Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and spread them in the dish.
Scatter the sausage and 1 1/2 cups of the shredded cheddar over the bread.
Whisk the eggs, milk, Dijon, salt and pepper and pour evenly over the top, pressing the bread down to soak. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Take the casserole out of the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking and heat the oven to 350°F.
Bake uncovered for 45 to 55 minutes, until puffed, golden and set in the center (a knife comes out clean and the center reaches 160°F).
Let rest 10 minutes, sprinkle with green onions and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Sausage and Rice
recipes.description: A one-pot Cajun-style dinner of smoked sausage, rice, tomatoes, peppers and celery.
steps: Slice the sausage into 1/2-inch coins. Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the sausage for 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add the diced onion, pepper and celery and cook for 5 minutes, until softened. Stir in the minced garlic, paprika, thyme and cayenne for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute to coat.
Stir in the broth, the tomatoes with their juice, salt, pepper and the sausage. Bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 18 to 20 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Remove from the heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and sprinkle with green onions.

recipes.title: Sausage Pasta
recipes.description: Penne tossed with Italian sausage, spinach and a creamy tomato sauce finished with Parmesan.
steps: Cook the penne in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Meanwhile, remove the sausage from its casings. Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat and cook the sausage for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and no longer pink.
Add the diced onion and cook for 4 minutes, then stir in the minced garlic and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Add the crushed tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream, then the spinach, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted.
Add the pasta and Parmesan and toss, adding pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce. Serve topped with torn basil and more Parmesan.

recipes.title: Shrimp Tacos
recipes.description: Chili-spiced seared shrimp in warm corn tortillas with crunchy cabbage and a creamy sriracha-lime sauce.
steps: Peel and devein the shrimp and pat dry. Toss with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt.
Whisk the sour cream, mayonnaise, sriracha and the juice of 1 lime.
Toss the thinly sliced cabbage with the chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the shrimp in a single layer for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with cabbage and shrimp, drizzle with the sauce and top with sliced avocado. Serve with the remaining lime cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fried Rice
recipes.description: Day-old jasmine rice stir-fried with shrimp, egg, peas, carrots and green onion in soy sauce and sesame oil.
steps: Cook the rice with 2 1/4 cups water a day ahead (or at least a few hours), spread it out to cool and refrigerate. You should have about 4 1/2 cups.
Peel and devein the shrimp, cut them into bite-size pieces and season with the salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Cook the shrimp for 2 minutes, until pink, and transfer to a plate.
Add 1/2 tablespoon oil, pour in the beaten eggs and scramble for about 1 minute, until just set. Add to the shrimp.
Add 1/2 tablespoon oil with the diced onion and carrots and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the minced garlic and peas and cook for 1 minute.
Add the remaining oil and the cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, until hot and lightly toasted.
Add the soy sauce and sesame oil, return the shrimp and eggs with the sliced green onions, and toss for 1 minute. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Coconut Shrimp
recipes.description: Large shrimp coated in sweetened coconut and panko, fried golden and served with a honey-lime-sriracha dipping sauce.
steps: Peel and devein the shrimp, leaving the tails on, and pat them very dry.
Set up three shallow dishes: the flour mixed with 1/2 teaspoon of the salt, the eggs beaten, and the coconut mixed with the panko.
Holding each shrimp by the tail, dredge it in flour, dip in egg, then press firmly into the coconut mixture. Set on a plate.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot or deep skillet to 350°F.
Fry the shrimp in batches for 2 to 3 minutes, turning once, until golden brown and opaque inside. Drain on a wire rack and sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Whisk the honey, sriracha and juice of the lime for dipping and serve with the shrimp.

recipes.title: Shrimp Alfredo
recipes.description: Fettuccine in a rich garlic butter, cream and Parmesan sauce with seared shrimp.
steps: Cook the fettuccine in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions. Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain.
Meanwhile, peel and devein the shrimp, pat dry and season with 1/4 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium, melt the butter and cook the minced garlic for 1 minute without browning.
Add the cream and remaining salt and simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes, until slightly thickened. Reduce the heat to low and whisk in the Parmesan until smooth.
Add the pasta and shrimp and toss, adding pasta water a little at a time if the sauce is too thick. Serve right away with parsley and extra Parmesan.

recipes.title: Blackened Fish
recipes.description: Thin fish fillets coated in a bold Cajun spice blend and seared in a very hot cast-iron skillet.
steps: Stir together the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, oregano, cayenne, black pepper and salt.
Pat the fillets dry. Melt the butter, brush 2 tablespoons over both sides of the fish and press the spice mixture evenly onto both sides.
Turn on the range hood and heat a large cast-iron skillet over high heat for about 5 minutes, until very hot.
Add the remaining tablespoon of butter and lay the fillets in the skillet. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until the crust is dark and the fish flakes easily and reaches 145°F.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Baked Cod
recipes.description: Cod fillets baked in lemon garlic butter until tender and flaky.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Pat the cod dry, arrange it in a single layer in a 9x13-inch baking dish and season with the salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a small saucepan and stir in the minced garlic, the juice of half the lemon and the zest of the whole lemon.
Pour the garlic butter over the fish and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, depending on thickness, until the fish is opaque, flakes easily and reaches 145°F.
Spoon the pan butter over the fillets, sprinkle with parsley and serve with the remaining lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Parmesan Crusted Tilapia
recipes.description: Tilapia fillets topped with a crisp Parmesan and panko crust and baked in a hot oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment or foil.
Pat the fillets dry, place them on the baking sheet and season with the salt and pepper.
In a bowl, combine the Parmesan, panko, zest of the lemon, garlic powder, paprika and olive oil.
Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise over the top of each fillet, then press the Parmesan mixture firmly on top.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the crust is golden and the fish flakes easily and reaches 145°F.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
recipes.description: Maryland-style crab cakes with lots of lump crab, just enough binder and a golden pan-fried crust.
steps: Spread the crab meat on a plate and pick through it for bits of shell, keeping the lumps as intact as possible.
In a large bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, egg, Dijon, Worcestershire, seafood seasoning, the juice of half the lemon and the chopped parsley.
Crush the saltines into fine crumbs (about 1/2 cup). Add them and the crab to the bowl and fold gently until just combined.
Shape into 8 cakes about 3/4 inch thick, place on a plate, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to firm up.
Heat the butter and oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the crab cakes for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until deep golden and heated through to 160°F.
Serve with the remaining lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: New England Clam Bake
recipes.description: A stovetop clam bake with littleneck clams, lobster tails, smoked sausage, red potatoes and corn steamed together in one big pot. Served with melted lemon-garlic butter.
steps: Scrub the clams under cold running water and discard any with cracked shells or that stay open when tapped. Keep them in the refrigerator until needed.
Cut the onion into thick wedges, slice the kielbasa into 2-inch pieces, shuck the corn and break each ear in half. Leave the small red potatoes whole (halve any larger than 2 inches).

In a 16-quart stockpot, combine the chicken broth, 2 cups water, 4 smashed garlic cloves, bay leaves, thyme, salt and the onion wedges. Add the potatoes, cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 10 minutes.
Add the kielbasa and corn, cover and cook for 5 minutes.

Using kitchen shears, cut down the top of each lobster tail shell. Lay the lobster tails and clams on top, cover tightly and steam for 8 to 10 minutes, until the clams open, the lobster shells are bright red and the lobster meat is opaque (145°F). Discard any clams that do not open.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small saucepan with the remaining 2 garlic cloves, minced. Cook for 1 minute, then stir in the juice of 1 lemon.

Lift everything out onto a large platter or a paper-lined table, cut the remaining lemon into wedges and sprinkle with parsley. Serve with the garlic butter for dipping and a little of the pot broth on the side.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
recipes.description: Seared chicken breast and crisp romaine tossed in Caesar dressing and Parmesan, rolled up in flour tortillas.
steps: Pound the chicken breasts to an even 3/4-inch thickness and season with garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 4 to 6 minutes per side, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Chop the romaine and toss it in a large bowl with the Caesar dressing, Parmesan and a squeeze of lemon if using.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 15 to 20 seconds so they fold without cracking.
Divide the romaine and chicken among the tortillas, fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Cut in half on the diagonal and serve.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
recipes.description: Spicy buffalo-sauced chicken with crunchy lettuce, celery, tomato and ranch, wrapped in a flour tortilla.
steps: Cut the chicken into 1/2-inch strips and season with garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken, turning occasionally, for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Reduce the heat to low and add the butter and hot sauce. Stir until the butter melts and the chicken is evenly coated, about 1 minute.
Shred the romaine, dice the tomato and thinly slice the celery.
Warm the tortillas for 15 to 20 seconds. Lay lettuce, tomato and celery down the center of each, top with buffalo chicken and drizzle with ranch.
Fold in the sides, roll up tightly and cut in half to serve.

recipes.title: BLT Wraps
recipes.description: Crisp bacon, lettuce and tomato with a little mayonnaise, rolled in a tortilla instead of served on toast.
steps: Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Shred the romaine and slice the tomatoes thinly. Slice the avocado if using.
Warm the tortillas for 15 to 20 seconds so they are pliable, then spread each with about 2 teaspoons of mayonnaise.
Layer romaine, tomato slices, 3 slices of bacon and avocado (if using) down the center of each tortilla and sprinkle with pepper.
Fold in the sides, roll up tightly and cut in half to serve.

recipes.title: Southwest Chicken Wraps
recipes.description: Chili-spiced chicken with black beans, corn, Monterey Jack, salsa and lime sour cream in a flour tortilla.
steps: Mix the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and salt and rub over the chicken.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 5 to 7 minutes per side, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
In the same skillet, warm the drained and rinsed black beans and the corn for 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir the juice of half the lime into the sour cream. Shred the cheese and the romaine.
Warm the tortillas, then fill each with romaine, the bean and corn mixture, chicken, cheese, salsa, a spoonful of lime sour cream and cilantro if using.
Fold in the sides, roll up tightly and cut in half. Serve with the remaining lime cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Bowls
recipes.description: Lemon-oregano chicken thighs over rice with cucumber, tomato, olives, feta and a quick homemade tzatziki.
steps: Whisk 2 tablespoons olive oil, the juice and zest of 1 lemon, 3 minced garlic cloves, the oregano, 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Toss with the chicken and marinate at least 20 minutes, or up to 8 hours refrigerated.
Bring the 3 cups chicken broth to a boil in a saucepan, stir in the rice, cover and simmer on low for 18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let stand covered 5 minutes, then fluff.

For the tzatziki, grate half the cucumber, squeeze out the liquid and stir it into the yogurt with the remaining garlic clove, minced, and the juice of half a lemon. Season with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt.

Heat the remaining tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side until browned and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Dice the remaining cucumber and the tomatoes, thinly slice the red onion and halve the olives.
Divide the rice among bowls and top with chicken, cucumber, tomato, onion, olives and feta. Add a spoonful of tzatziki and serve with the remaining lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Burrito Bowls
recipes.description: Spiced chicken thighs over cilantro-lime rice with black beans, corn, salsa, cheese, sour cream and avocado.
steps: Combine the chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Toss the chicken with the spice mix and the juice of 1 lime.
Bring the 3 cups broth to a boil, stir in the rice, cover and simmer on low for 18 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes, then fluff with the juice of the second lime and the chopped cilantro.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes and chop.
Warm the drained and rinsed black beans with the corn and the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt in a small saucepan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes.
Shred the romaine and the cheese, and slice the avocado.
Build the bowls with rice, beans and corn, chicken and romaine, then top with salsa, cheese, sour cream and avocado.

recipes.title: Taco Bowls
recipes.description: Taco-seasoned ground beef over rice with pinto beans, crisp lettuce, tomato, cheddar and all the usual taco toppings.
steps: Bring the 3 cups broth to a boil, stir in the rice, cover and simmer on low for 18 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes, then fluff.
Meanwhile, brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, for 7 to 8 minutes until no pink remains. Drain off excess fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and tomato sauce and simmer 3 to 4 minutes until thickened.
Warm the drained pinto beans in a small saucepan or the microwave.
Shred the lettuce, dice the tomato, shred the cheddar, and slice the green onions and jalapeño if using.
Divide the rice among bowls and top with beans, taco meat, lettuce, tomato, cheddar, salsa and sour cream. Garnish with green onions and jalapeño if desired.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Chicken thighs in a homemade sweet soy teriyaki sauce with steamed broccoli over jasmine rice.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it with 2 1/4 cups water: bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes, then let stand covered 10 minutes.
Whisk the soy sauce, brown sugar, honey, rice vinegar, minced garlic, grated ginger, cornstarch and 1/4 cup cold water until the cornstarch dissolves.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 6 to 8 minutes until browned and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Stir the sauce again, pour it in and simmer, stirring, 1 to 2 minutes until glossy and thickened.
Meanwhile, steam the broccoli florets over simmering water for 4 to 5 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender.
Divide the rice among bowls, top with the chicken and sauce and the broccoli, and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken Bowls
recipes.description: Chicken, pineapple, bell pepper and red onion in a sweet and tangy soy glaze over jasmine rice.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it with 2 1/4 cups water: bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes, then let stand covered 10 minutes.
Whisk the soy sauce, brown sugar, ketchup, rice vinegar, minced garlic, grated ginger, cornstarch and 1/4 cup water.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces, the pineapple into chunks, and the bell pepper and onion into 1-inch pieces.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 6 to 8 minutes until browned and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Transfer to a plate.
Add the bell pepper and onion to the skillet and cook 3 minutes, then add the pineapple and cook 2 minutes more until lightly caramelized.
Return the chicken, stir the sauce again and pour it in. Simmer 1 to 2 minutes until thickened and glossy.
Serve over the rice, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Grain Bowls
recipes.description: Quinoa bowls with chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, olives, spinach and feta under a lemon-tahini dressing.
steps: Rinse the quinoa in a fine-mesh strainer. Bring the vegetable broth to a boil, add the quinoa, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes, then fluff.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas and pat them dry.
Dice the cucumber and tomatoes, thinly slice the red onion and halve the olives.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, grated garlic, salt and pepper with 2 to 3 tablespoons water until smooth and pourable.
Divide the spinach and quinoa among bowls and top with chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, onion, olives and feta.
Drizzle with the tahini dressing and sprinkle with chopped parsley if using.

recipes.title: Chicken and Broccoli Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Tender chicken and broccoli stir-fried in a savory garlic-ginger sauce and served over brown rice.
steps: Cook the brown rice with 3 1/2 cups water: bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for 45 minutes, then let stand covered 10 minutes.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and toss with 1/2 tablespoon of the cornstarch.
Whisk the soy sauce, chicken broth, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil and the remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes until browned and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Transfer to a plate.
Add the broccoli and 2 tablespoons water to the skillet, cover and cook 3 minutes until crisp-tender. Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, stir in the sauce and simmer 1 to 2 minutes until thickened.
Serve over the brown rice, sprinkled with sesame seeds if using.

recipes.title: BBQ Chicken Bowls
recipes.description: Grilled barbecue chicken over rice with black beans, charred corn, cheddar and red onion.
steps: Bring the 3 cups broth to a boil, stir in the rice, cover and simmer on low for 18 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes, then fluff.
Heat a grill to medium-high (about 425°F) and oil the grates. Rub the chicken with oil and season with smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Grill the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side. Brush with half the BBQ sauce during the last 2 minutes and grill until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Meanwhile, cook the thawed corn in a dry skillet over high heat for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly charred. Warm the drained and rinsed black beans.
Finely dice the red onion and shred the cheddar.
Build the bowls with rice, beans, corn and chicken. Drizzle with the remaining BBQ sauce, then top with cheddar, red onion, cilantro and ranch if using.

recipes.title: Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Baked sweet potatoes filled with a cumin-spiced black bean, corn and pepper mix, topped with cheese, yogurt and lime.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Scrub the sweet potatoes, prick each several times with a fork and bake on a foil-lined sheet for 45 to 60 minutes, until a knife slides easily into the center.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the diced bell pepper and onion for 5 minutes until softened.
Add the drained and rinsed black beans, corn, cumin, chili powder and salt. Cook 4 to 5 minutes until hot, then squeeze in half the lime.
Stir the juice of the remaining lime half into the yogurt.
Split each sweet potato lengthwise and fluff the flesh with a fork. Spoon in the bean filling and top with shredded cheese.
Return to the oven for 3 to 5 minutes to melt the cheese. Top with the lime yogurt, cilantro and diced avocado if using.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
recipes.description: Creamy mashed sweet potatoes baked under a crunchy brown sugar and pecan topping, a holiday-table classic.
steps: Peel the sweet potatoes (about 3 pounds) and cut into 1-inch cubes. Cover with cold salted water, bring to a boil and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until very tender. Drain well.
Heat the oven to 350°F and butter a 2-quart or 8x11-inch baking dish.
Mash the sweet potatoes until smooth; you should have about 3 cups. Beat in the granulated sugar, eggs, milk, 5 tablespoons melted butter, vanilla and salt. Spread in the baking dish.
For the topping, mix the brown sugar, flour and chopped pecans, then stir in the remaining 5 tablespoons melted butter until crumbly. Sprinkle evenly over the potatoes.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the topping is browned and the center is set.
Let rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
recipes.description: Baked russet potatoes scooped out, mashed with sour cream, cheddar and bacon, then piled back into the skins and baked until golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Scrub the potatoes, prick with a fork, rub with olive oil and 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, and bake directly on the oven rack for 55 to 65 minutes, until tender all the way through.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon until crisp, drain on paper towels and crumble.
Let the potatoes cool 10 minutes, then halve lengthwise. Scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving a 1/4-inch shell.
Mash the potato flesh with the butter, sour cream, milk, the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Stir in two-thirds of the shredded cheddar, most of the bacon and most of the green onions.
Spoon the filling into the potato shells, mounding it, and set them on a baking sheet. Top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until hot and the cheese is melted and lightly golden. Sprinkle with the remaining bacon and green onions before serving.

recipes.title: Au Gratin Potatoes
recipes.description: Thinly sliced potatoes baked in a garlicky cream sauce with cheddar and Parmesan until bubbling and browned on top.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Peel the potatoes (about 3 pounds) and slice them 1/8 inch thick with a mandoline or sharp knife.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute.

Slowly whisk in the milk and cream and simmer, whisking, 3 to 4 minutes until slightly thickened. Stir in the thyme, salt, pepper and nutmeg, then remove from the heat and stir in half the cheddar and half the Parmesan.
Layer the potatoes in the dish, pouring sauce over each layer, and finish with sauce. Top with the remaining cheddar and Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 30 to 40 minutes more, until the potatoes are tender when pierced and the top is golden and bubbling.
Let stand 15 minutes before serving so the sauce sets.

recipes.title: Roasted Potatoes
recipes.description: Crispy oven-roasted red potatoes with olive oil, garlic and fresh rosemary.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F with a rack in the lower third.
Cut the potatoes into 1 1/2-inch chunks and pat dry.
Toss the potatoes with the olive oil, garlic powder, chopped rosemary, salt and pepper.
Spread in a single layer, cut sides down, on a large rimmed baking sheet.
Roast 20 minutes, flip, and roast 15 to 20 minutes more until deep golden and crisp outside and tender inside. Taste for salt and serve hot.

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Potatoes
recipes.description: Halved red potatoes roasted with garlic and Italian herbs and finished with a crisp Parmesan crust.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment.
Halve or quarter the potatoes into 1-inch pieces. Toss with 2 tablespoons olive oil, the Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Roast cut side down for 20 minutes.
Mix the minced garlic with the remaining tablespoon of oil. Toss it with the potatoes, then sprinkle the Parmesan evenly over them.
Roast 10 to 15 minutes more until the potatoes are tender and the Parmesan is melted and golden.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley if using and serve hot.

recipes.title: Potato Wedges
recipes.description: Seasoned russet potato wedges baked until crisp outside and fluffy inside.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment.
Scrub the potatoes, halve them lengthwise and cut each half into 4 wedges. Soak in cold water for 15 minutes, then drain and dry thoroughly.
Toss the wedges with the olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper.
Arrange in a single layer with a cut side down and bake 20 minutes. Flip and bake 10 to 15 minutes more until golden and crisp.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and parsley if using and serve hot.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.description: Oven-baked sweet potato fries tossed with cornstarch and smoked paprika for crisp edges.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Peel the sweet potatoes (about 2 pounds) and cut into 1/4-inch-thick sticks. Pat dry.
Toss the fries with the cornstarch until lightly coated, then add the oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder and pepper and toss again.
Spread in a single layer with space between the fries, using both pans so they don't crowd.
Bake 15 minutes, flip, and bake 10 to 15 minutes more until browned and crisp at the edges.
Sprinkle with the kosher salt while hot and serve right away.

recipes.title: Green Beans Almondine
recipes.description: Blanched green beans tossed in browned butter with toasted sliced almonds, shallot and lemon.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and prepare a bowl of ice water. Trim the green beans.
Boil the green beans 3 to 4 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender. Drain and plunge into the ice water, then drain and pat dry.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced almonds and cook, stirring, 2 to 3 minutes until the almonds are golden and the butter smells nutty.
Add the minced shallot and cook 1 minute.
